To address this issue, we propose Multi-Faceted Self-Consistent Preference Aligned CQR (MSPA-CQR). Specifically, we first construct self-consistent preference alignment data from three dimensions (rewriting, retrieval, and response) to generate more diverse rewritten queries. Then we propose prefix guided multi-faceted direct preference optimization to learn preference information from three different dimensions. The experimental results show that our MSPA-CQR is effective in both in- and out-of-distribution scenarios.

AI.tldr: MSPA-CQR是一种多维度自洽偏好对齐的对话查询重写方法，通过构建三个维度（重写、检索、响应）的自洽偏好对齐数据，并使用前缀引导的多维度直接偏好优化来学习偏好信息，在分布内和分布外场景都表现有效。
AI.motivation: 早期对话查询重写研究主要关注孤立的重写过程，忽略了查询重写、段落检索和响应生成之间的反馈循环。为了解决这个问题，需要一种能够整合多维度反馈的重写方法。
AI.method: 1. 从三个维度（重写、检索、响应）构建自洽偏好对齐数据，生成更多样化的重写查询；2. 提出前缀引导的多维度直接偏好优化，从三个不同维度学习偏好信息。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，MSPA-CQR在分布内和分布外场景中都表现有效。
AI.conclusion: 通过整合多维度反馈和偏好对齐，MSPA-CQR能够更有效地进行对话查询重写，提升对话搜索效率。

title: Compression as an Adversarial Amplifier Through Decision Space Reduction
summary: Image compression is a ubiquitous component of modern visual pipelines, routinely applied by social media platforms and resource-constrained systems prior to inference. Despite its prevalence, the impact of compression on adversarial robustness remains poorly understood. We study a previously unexplored adversarial setting in which attacks are applied directly in compressed representations, and show that compression can act as an adversarial amplifier for deep image classifiers. Under identical nominal perturbation budgets, compression-aware attacks are substantially more effective than their pixel-space counterparts. We attribute this effect to decision space reduction, whereby compression induces a non-invertible, information-losing transformation that contracts classification margins and increases sensitivity to perturbations. Extensive experiments across standard benchmarks and architectures support our analysis and reveal a critical vulnerability in compression-in-the-loop deployment settings. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 压缩感知攻击比像素空间攻击更有效，压缩会放大对抗脆弱性
AI.motivation: 图像压缩是现代视觉系统的普遍组件，但压缩对对抗鲁棒性的影响研究不足。作者探索压缩表示中的直接攻击场景，发现压缩会放大对抗脆弱性。
AI.method: 研究压缩表示中的直接攻击，提出压缩感知攻击方法。通过决策空间缩减理论分析压缩如何收缩分类边界并增加对扰动的敏感性。
AI.result: 在相同扰动预算下，压缩感知攻击比像素空间攻击更有效。压缩会放大对抗脆弱性，在压缩循环部署设置中存在严重漏洞。
AI.conclusion: 压缩会放大深度图像分类器的对抗脆弱性，压缩感知攻击比传统像素空间攻击更有效。这揭示了压缩在部署系统中的关键安全漏洞。

title: Discourse Coherence and Response-Guided Context Rewriting for Multi-Party Dialogue Generation
summary: Previous research on multi-party dialogue generation has predominantly leveraged structural information inherent in dialogues to directly inform the generation process. However, the prevalence of colloquial expressions and incomplete utterances in dialogues often impedes comprehension and weakens the fidelity of dialogue structure representations, which is particularly pronounced in multi-party dialogues. In this work, we propose a novel framework DRCR (Discourse coherence and Response-guided Context Rewriting) to improve multi-party dialogue generation through dialogue context rewriting. Specifically, DRCR employs two complementary feedback signals, discourse coherence and response quality, to construct preference data for both context rewriting and response generation. Moreover, we propose a dynamic self-evolution learning method that allows the rewriter and responder to continuously enhance their capabilities through mutual interaction in an iterative training loop. Comprehensive experiments conducted on four multi-party dialogue datasets substantiate the effectiveness of DRCR.

AI.tldr: 提出DRCR框架，通过对话上下文重写改进多方对话生成，使用话语连贯性和响应质量作为反馈信号，并采用动态自进化学习方法
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要利用对话结构信息直接指导生成，但对话中的口语化表达和不完整话语会阻碍理解并削弱对话结构表示的保真度，这在多方对话中尤为明显
AI.method: 提出DRCR框架，使用话语连贯性和响应质量两个互补反馈信号构建偏好数据，用于上下文重写和响应生成；采用动态自进化学习方法，让重写器和响应器在迭代训练循环中通过相互交互持续增强能力
AI.result: 在四个多方对话数据集上的综合实验证实了DRCR的有效性
AI.conclusion: 通过对话上下文重写和动态自进化学习，DRCR框架能够有效改进多方对话生成的质量

title: Auditing Demographic Bias in Facial Landmark Detection for Fair Human-Robot Interaction
summary: Fairness in human-robot interaction critically depends on the reliability of the perceptual models that enable robots to interpret human behavior. While demographic biases have been widely studied in high-level facial analysis tasks, their presence in facial landmark detection remains unexplored. In this paper, we conduct a systematic audit of demographic bias in this task, analyzing the age, gender and race biases. To this end we introduce a controlled statistical methodology to disentangle demographic effects from confounding visual factors. Evaluations of a standard representative model demonstrate that confounding visual factors, particularly head pose and image resolution, heavily outweigh the impact of demographic attributes. Notably, after accounting for these confounders, we show that performance disparities across gender and race vanish. However, we identify a statistically significant age-related effect, with higher biases observed for older individuals. This shows that fairness issues can emerge even in low-level vision components and can propagate through the HRI pipeline, disproportionately affecting vulnerable populations. We argue that auditing and correcting such biases is a necessary step toward trustworthy and equitable robot perception systems.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统审计了面部关键点检测模型中的年龄、性别和种族偏见，发现混淆视觉因素（头部姿态和图像分辨率）比人口统计属性影响更大。控制这些因素后，性别和种族差异消失，但年龄偏见仍然显著存在。
AI.motivation: 人机交互中的公平性依赖于机器人感知模型的可靠性。虽然人口统计偏见在高层面部分析任务中已被广泛研究，但在面部关键点检测任务中的偏见尚未被探索。本研究旨在填补这一空白，确保机器人感知系统的公平性和可信度。
AI.method: 引入受控统计方法来分离人口统计效应与混淆视觉因素（如头部姿态和图像分辨率），对标准代表性模型进行系统评估，分析年龄、性别和种族偏见。
AI.result: 评估显示混淆视觉因素（特别是头部姿态和图像分辨率）的影响远大于人口统计属性。控制这些因素后，性别和种族间的性能差异消失，但发现年龄相关的统计显著效应，对年长个体的偏见更高。
AI.conclusion: 公平性问题可能出现在低级视觉组件中，并通过人机交互管道传播，对弱势群体造成不成比例的影响。审计和纠正此类偏见是构建可信和公平的机器人感知系统的必要步骤。

title: When Is Thinking Enough? Early Exit via Sufficiency Assessment for Efficient Reasoning
summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) have achieved remarkable performance in complex reasoning tasks, driven by their powerful inference-time scaling capability. However, LRMs often suffer from overthinking, which results in substantial computational redundancy and significantly reduces efficiency. Early-exit methods aim to mitigate this issue by terminating reasoning once sufficient evidence has been generated, yet existing approaches mostly rely on handcrafted or empirical indicators that are unreliable and impractical. In this work, we introduce Dynamic Thought Sufficiency in Reasoning (DTSR), a novel framework for efficient reasoning that enables the model to dynamically assess the sufficiency of its chain-of-thought (CoT) and determine the optimal point for early exit. Inspired by human metacognition, DTSR operates in two stages: (1) Reflection Signal Monitoring, which identifies reflection signals as potential cues for early exit, and (2) Thought Sufficiency Check, which evaluates whether the current CoT is sufficient to derive the final answer. Experimental results on the Qwen3 models show that DTSR reduces reasoning length by 28.9%-34.9% with minimal performance loss, effectively mitigating overthinking. We further discuss overconfidence in LRMs and self-evaluation paradigms, providing valuable insights for early-exit reasoning.

AI.tldr: DTSR框架通过动态评估思维链的充分性来实现高效推理，减少大型推理模型的过度思考问题，在保持性能的同时显著缩短推理长度。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型在复杂推理任务中表现出色，但存在过度思考问题，导致计算冗余和效率降低。现有的提前退出方法主要依赖手工或经验指标，这些方法不可靠且不实用。
AI.method: 提出DTSR框架，受人类元认知启发，包含两个阶段：1) 反思信号监测，识别作为提前退出潜在线索的反思信号；2) 思维充分性检查，评估当前思维链是否足以推导最终答案。
AI.result: 在Qwen3模型上的实验结果显示，DTSR将推理长度减少了28.9%-34.9%，同时性能损失最小，有效缓解了过度思考问题。
AI.conclusion: DTSR为高效推理提供了新框架，能够动态评估思维链充分性并确定最佳提前退出点。研究还讨论了大型推理模型的过度自信问题和自我评估范式，为提前退出推理提供了有价值的见解。

title: MAR-GRPO: Stabilized GRPO for AR-diffusion Hybrid Image Generation
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has been successfully applied to autoregressive (AR) and diffusion models. However, extending RL to hybrid AR-diffusion frameworks remains challenging due to interleaved inference and noisy log-probability estimation. In this work, we study masked autoregressive models (MAR) and show that the diffusion head plays a critical role in training dynamics, often introducing noisy gradients that lead to instability and early performance saturation. To address this issue, we propose a stabilized RL framework for MAR. We introduce multi-trajectory expectation (MTE), which estimates the optimization direction by averaging over multiple diffusion trajectories, thereby reducing diffusion-induced gradient noise. To avoid over-smoothing, we further estimate token-wise uncertainty from multiple trajectories and apply multi-trajectory optimization only to the top-k% uncertain tokens. In addition, we introduce a consistency-aware token selection strategy that filters out AR tokens that are less aligned with the final generated content. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently improves visual quality, training stability, and spatial structure understanding over baseline GRPO and pre-RL models. Code is available at: https://github.com/AMAP-ML/mar-grpo.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对混合自回归-扩散模型（MAR）的稳定强化学习框架，通过多轨迹期望和不确定性感知优化解决扩散头带来的梯度噪声问题。
AI.motivation: 强化学习已成功应用于自回归和扩散模型，但扩展到混合AR-扩散框架仍具挑战性，主要问题包括交错推理和噪声对数概率估计。扩散头在训练动态中引入噪声梯度，导致不稳定性和早期性能饱和。
AI.method: 提出稳定RL框架：1）多轨迹期望（MTE），通过对多个扩散轨迹取平均来估计优化方向，减少扩散诱导的梯度噪声；2）基于不确定性的多轨迹优化，仅对top-k%不确定的token应用；3）一致性感知token选择策略，过滤与最终生成内容对齐度低的AR token。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上的广泛实验表明，该方法在视觉质量、训练稳定性和空间结构理解方面均优于基线GRPO和预RL模型。
AI.conclusion: 提出的稳定RL框架有效解决了混合AR-扩散模型的训练挑战，通过多轨迹期望和不确定性感知优化显著提升了模型性能和训练稳定性。

title: GCoT-Decoding: Unlocking Deep Reasoning Paths for Universal Question Answering
summary: Chain-of-Thought reasoning can enhance large language models, but it requires manually designed prompts to guide the model. Recently proposed CoT-decoding enables the model to generate CoT-style reasoning paths without prompts, but it is only applicable to problems with fixed answer sets. To address this limitation, we propose a general decoding strategy GCoT-decoding that extends applicability to a broader range of question-answering tasks. GCoT-decoding employs a two-stage branching method combining Fibonacci sampling and heuristic error backtracking to generate candidate decoding paths. It then splits each path into a reasoning span and an answer span to accurately compute path confidence, and finally aggregates semantically similar paths to identify a consensus answer, replacing traditional majority voting. We conduct extensive experiments on six datasets covering both fixed and free QA tasks. Our method not only maintains strong performance on fixed QA but also achieves significant improvements on free QA, demonstrating its generality.

AI.tldr: GCoT-decoding是一种通用的解码策略，通过两阶段分支方法结合斐波那契采样和启发式错误回溯生成候选解码路径，然后分割推理段和答案段计算置信度，最后聚合语义相似路径识别共识答案，适用于固定和自由QA任务。
AI.motivation: 现有CoT推理需要手动设计提示，而CoT-decoding虽然无需提示但仅适用于固定答案集的问题。为了解决这一局限性，需要开发适用于更广泛问答任务的通用解码策略。
AI.method: 提出GCoT-decoding解码策略：1）使用斐波那契采样和启发式错误回溯的两阶段分支方法生成候选解码路径；2）将每条路径分割为推理段和答案段以准确计算路径置信度；3）聚合语义相似路径识别共识答案，替代传统多数投票。
AI.result: 在六个数据集（涵盖固定和自由QA任务）上进行广泛实验，GCoT-decoding不仅在固定QA上保持强大性能，在自由QA上也取得显著改进，证明了其通用性。
AI.conclusion: GCoT-decoding是一种通用的解码策略，成功扩展了CoT推理的应用范围，使其适用于更广泛的问答任务，包括固定和自由答案格式的问题。

title: CAAP: Capture-Aware Adversarial Patch Attacks on Palmprint Recognition Models
summary: Palmprint recognition is deployed in security-critical applications, including access control and palm-based payment, due to its contactless acquisition and highly discriminative ridge-and-crease textures. However, the robustness of deep palmprint recognition systems against physically realizable attacks remains insufficiently understood. Existing studies are largely confined to the digital setting and do not adequately account for the texture-dominant nature of palmprint recognition or the distortions introduced during physical acquisition. To address this gap, we propose CAAP, a capture-aware adversarial patch framework for palmprint recognition. CAAP learns a universal patch that can be reused across inputs while remaining effective under realistic acquisition variation. To match the structural characteristics of palmprints, the framework adopts a cross-shaped patch topology, which enlarges spatial coverage under a fixed pixel budget and more effectively disrupts long-range texture continuity. CAAP further integrates three modules: ASIT for input-conditioned patch rendering, RaS for stochastic capture-aware simulation, and MS-DIFE for feature-level identity-disruptive guidance. We evaluate CAAP on the Tongji, IITD, and AISEC datasets against generic CNN backbones and palmprint-specific recognition models. Experiments show that CAAP achieves strong untargeted and targeted attack performance with favorable cross-model and cross-dataset transferability. The results further show that, although adversarial training can partially reduce the attack success rate, substantial residual vulnerability remains. These findings indicate that deep palmprint recognition systems remain vulnerable to physically realizable, capture-aware adversarial patch attacks, underscoring the need for more effective defenses in practice. Code available at https://github.com/ryliu68/CAAP.

AI.tldr: CAAP是一种针对掌纹识别的捕获感知对抗性补丁框架，通过十字形补丁拓扑和三个核心模块，在物理采集变化下实现有效的通用攻击，揭示了深度掌纹识别系统在物理攻击面前的脆弱性。
AI.motivation: 当前深度掌纹识别系统在物理可实现攻击下的鲁棒性研究不足，现有研究主要局限于数字环境，未能充分考虑掌纹识别的纹理主导特性以及物理采集过程中的失真问题。
AI.method: 提出CAAP框架，采用十字形补丁拓扑扩大空间覆盖；包含三个核心模块：ASIT用于输入条件补丁渲染，RaS用于随机捕获感知模拟，MS-DIFE用于特征级身份破坏指导。
AI.result: 在Tongji、IITD和AISEC数据集上评估，CAAP在非定向和定向攻击中均表现出色，具有良好的跨模型和跨数据集可迁移性；对抗训练只能部分降低攻击成功率，系统仍存在显著脆弱性。
AI.conclusion: 深度掌纹识别系统对物理可实现、捕获感知的对抗性补丁攻击仍然脆弱，需要在实践中开发更有效的防御措施。

title: Beyond Accuracy: Diagnosing Algebraic Reasoning Failures in LLMs Across Nine Complexity Dimensions
comment: Under Review as a conference paper at COLM 2026
summary: Algebraic reasoning remains one of the most informative stress tests for large language models, yet current benchmarks provide no mechanism for attributing failure to a specific cause. When a model fails an algebraic problem, a single accuracy score cannot reveal whether the expression was too deeply nested, the operator too uncommon, the intermediate state count too high, or the dependency chain too long. Prior work has studied individual failure modes in isolation, but no framework has varied each complexity factor independently under strict experimental control. No prior system has offered automatic generation and verification of problems of increasing complexity to track model progress over time. We introduce a nine-dimension algebraic complexity framework in which each factor is varied independently while all others are held fixed, with problem generation and verification handled by a parametric pipeline requiring no human annotation. Each dimension is grounded in a documented LLM failure mode and captures a structurally distinct aspect of algebraic difficulty, including expression nesting depth, simultaneous intermediate result count, sub-expression complexity, operator hardness, and dependent reasoning chain length. We evaluated seven instruction-tuned models spanning 8B to 235B parameters across all nine dimensions and find that working memory is the dominant scale-invariant bottleneck. Every model collapses between 20 and 30 parallel branches regardless of parameter count, pointing to a hard architectural constraint rather than a solvable capacity limitation. Our analysis further identifies a minimal yet diagnostically sufficient subset of five dimensions that together span the full space of documented algebraic failure modes, providing a complete complexity profile of a model's algebraic reasoning capacity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个九维代数复杂度框架，用于独立分析LLM在代数推理中的具体失败原因，发现工作记忆是主要的规模不变瓶颈，所有模型在20-30个并行分支处崩溃。
AI.motivation: 当前代数推理基准测试无法具体定位模型失败的原因，单一准确率分数无法揭示失败是由于表达式嵌套过深、运算符不常见、中间状态过多还是依赖链过长等具体因素。缺乏系统框架来独立控制每个复杂度因素并自动生成验证问题。
AI.method: 提出了一个九维代数复杂度框架，每个维度对应一个已记录的LLM失败模式，包括表达式嵌套深度、并行中间结果数量、子表达式复杂度、运算符难度和依赖推理链长度等。通过参数化管道自动生成和验证问题，独立变化每个维度同时固定其他维度。
AI.result: 评估了7个指令调优模型（8B到235B参数），发现工作记忆是主要的规模不变瓶颈。所有模型在20-30个并行分支处崩溃，与参数数量无关，表明这是硬架构约束而非可解决的容量限制。进一步确定了5个最小但诊断充分的维度子集。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够全面分析模型代数推理能力的复杂度特征，识别出工作记忆是核心瓶颈，并提供了自动化的评估工具来跟踪模型在特定失败模式上的进展。

title: Canopy Tree Height Estimation Using Quantile Regression: Modeling and Evaluating Uncertainty in Remote Sensing
summary: Accurate tree height estimation is vital for ecological monitoring and biomass assessment. We apply quantile regression to existing tree height estimation models based on satellite data to incorporate uncertainty quantification. Most current approaches for tree height estimation rely on point predictions, which limits their applicability in risk-sensitive scenarios. In this work, we show that, with minor modifications of a given prediction head, existing models can be adapted to provide statistically calibrated uncertainty estimates via quantile regression. Furthermore, we demonstrate how our results correlate with known challenges in remote sensing (e.g., terrain complexity, vegetation heterogeneity), indicating that the model is less confident in more challenging conditions.

AI.tldr: 该研究将分位数回归应用于基于卫星数据的树高估算模型，为现有模型添加不确定性量化功能，以解决传统点预测方法在风险敏感场景中的局限性。
AI.motivation: 准确的树高估算对生态监测和生物量评估至关重要。当前大多数树高估算方法依赖点预测，缺乏不确定性量化，限制了其在风险敏感场景中的应用。需要一种方法能够为现有模型提供统计校准的不确定性估计。
AI.method: 通过分位数回归对现有树高估算模型进行微小修改，将传统预测头调整为能够提供不确定性估计的版本。该方法保持原有模型架构基本不变，仅对预测头进行适应性调整。
AI.result: 研究成功将现有树高估算模型转换为能够提供统计校准不确定性估计的版本。模型的不确定性估计与遥感中已知的挑战（如地形复杂性、植被异质性）相关，表明模型在更具挑战性的条件下信心较低。
AI.conclusion: 通过分位数回归对现有树高估算模型进行微小修改，可以有效为这些模型添加不确定性量化功能。这种方法使模型能够识别并量化预测中的不确定性，特别是在地形复杂和植被异质性高的区域，为生态监测和生物量评估提供了更可靠的决策支持。

title: Cognitive Loop of Thought: Reversible Hierarchical Markov Chain for Efficient Mathematical Reasoning
summary: Multi-step Chain-of-Thought (CoT) has significantly advanced the mathematical reasoning capabilities of LLMs by leveraging explicit reasoning steps. However, the widespread adoption of Long CoT often results in sequence lengths that exceed manageable computational limits. While existing approaches attempt to alleviate this by reducing KV Cache redundancy via Markov chain-like structures, they introduce two critical limitations: inherent memorylessness (loss of context) and limited backward reasoning capability. To address these limitations, we propose a novel Chain-of-Thought framework based on Reversible Hierarchical Markov Chain, termed Cognitive Loop of Thought (CLoT), and a backward reasoning dataset CLoT-Instruct. In CLoT, problems are decomposed into sub-problems with hierarchical dependencies. Inspired by human cognitive processes, we introduce a backward verification mechanism at each hierarchical layer. Furthermore, we implement a pruning strategy: once higher-level sub-problems are verified, redundant lower-level sub-problems are pruned to maximize efficiency. This approach effectively mitigates error propagation and enhances reasoning robustness. Experiments on four mathematical benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our method. Notably, on the AddSub dataset using GPT-4o-mini, CLoT achieves 99.0% accuracy, outperforming traditional CoT and CoT-SC by 4.1% and 2.9%, respectively.

AI.tldr: CLoT是一个基于可逆分层马尔可夫链的思维链框架，通过分层分解问题、引入后向验证机制和剪枝策略，解决长思维链中的计算限制和上下文丢失问题。
AI.motivation: 长思维链（Long CoT）经常超出计算限制，现有方法通过类似马尔可夫链的结构减少KV缓存冗余，但存在两个关键限制：固有的无记忆性（上下文丢失）和后向推理能力有限。
AI.method: 提出基于可逆分层马尔可夫链的认知思维循环（CLoT）框架：1）将问题分解为具有层次依赖关系的子问题；2）受人类认知过程启发，在每个层次引入后向验证机制；3）实现剪枝策略，一旦高层子问题被验证，就剪枝冗余的低层子问题。
AI.result: 在四个数学基准测试上验证了方法的有效性。在AddSub数据集上使用GPT-4o-mini，CLoT达到99.0%准确率，分别比传统CoT和CoT-SC高出4.1%和2.9%。
AI.conclusion: CLoT框架通过分层后向验证和剪枝策略，有效缓解了错误传播，增强了推理鲁棒性，在数学推理任务上取得了显著性能提升。

title: Generative Phomosaic with Structure-Aligned and Personalized Diffusion
summary: We present the first generative approach to photomosaic creation. Traditional photomosaic methods rely on a large number of tile images and color-based matching, which limits both diversity and structural consistency. Our generative photomosaic framework synthesizes tile images using diffusion-based generation conditioned on reference images. A low-frequency conditioned diffusion mechanism aligns global structure while preserving prompt-driven details. This generative formulation enables photomosaic composition that is both semantically expressive and structurally coherent, effectively overcoming the fundamental limitations of matching-based approaches. By leveraging few-shot personalized diffusion, our model is able to produce user-specific or stylistically consistent tiles without requiring an extensive collection of images.

AI.tldr: 首个生成式照片马赛克方法，使用扩散模型合成瓦片图像，替代传统基于颜色匹配的方法
AI.motivation: 传统照片马赛克方法依赖大量瓦片图像和基于颜色的匹配，限制了多样性和结构一致性。现有方法在语义表达和结构连贯性方面存在根本性限制。
AI.method: 提出生成式照片马赛克框架，使用基于扩散的生成模型，通过参考图像条件化。采用低频条件扩散机制对齐全局结构，同时保留提示驱动的细节。利用少样本个性化扩散技术，无需大量图像集合即可生成用户特定或风格一致的瓦片。
AI.result: 该方法能够创建语义表达丰富且结构连贯的照片马赛克，有效克服了基于匹配方法的根本限制。生成模型能够产生多样化的瓦片图像，同时保持整体结构一致性。
AI.conclusion: 生成式照片马赛克框架通过扩散模型实现了语义表达和结构连贯性的平衡，为照片马赛克创作提供了新的范式，克服了传统匹配方法的局限性。

title: AGSC: Adaptive Granularity and Semantic Clustering for Uncertainty Quantification in Long-text Generation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in long-form generation, yet their application is hindered by the hallucination problem. While Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) is essential for assessing reliability, the complex structure makes reliable aggregation across heterogeneous themes difficult, in addition, existing methods often overlook the nuance of neutral information and suffer from the high computational cost of fine-grained decomposition. To address these challenges, we propose AGSC (Adaptive Granularity and GMM-based Semantic Clustering), a UQ framework tailored for long-form generation. AGSC first uses NLI neutral probabilities as triggers to distinguish irrelevance from uncertainty, reducing unnecessary computation. It then applies Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) soft clustering to model latent semantic themes and assign topic-aware weights for downstream aggregation. Experiments on BIO and LongFact show that AGSC achieves state-of-the-art correlation with factuality while reducing inference time by about 60% compared to full atomic decomposition.

AI.tldr: AGSC框架通过自适应粒度和GMM语义聚类解决长文本生成中的幻觉问题，在保持事实性评估准确性的同时减少60%推理时间
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在长文本生成中存在幻觉问题，现有不确定性量化方法难以跨异构主题可靠聚合，且忽略中性信息细微差别，计算成本高
AI.method: 提出AGSC框架：1)使用NLI中性概率作为触发器区分无关信息和不确定性；2)应用高斯混合模型软聚类建模潜在语义主题，为下游聚合分配主题感知权重
AI.result: 在BIO和LongFact数据集上，AGSC在事实性相关性方面达到最先进水平，相比完整原子分解减少约60%推理时间
AI.conclusion: AGSC框架有效解决了长文本生成中不确定性量化的挑战，平衡了评估准确性和计算效率

title: IQ-LUT: interpolated and quantized LUT for efficient image super-resolution
summary: Lookup table (LUT) methods demonstrate considerable potential in accelerating image super-resolution inference. However, pursuing higher image quality through larger receptive fields and bit-depth triggers exponential growth in the LUT's index space, creating a storage bottleneck that limits deployment on resource-constrained devices. We introduce IQ-LUT, which achieves a reduction in LUT size while simultaneously enhancing super-resolution quality. First, we integrate interpolation and quantization into the single-input, multiple-output ECNN, which dramatically reduces the index space and thereby the overall LUT size. Second, the integration of residual learning mitigates the dependence on LUT bit-depth, which facilitates training stability and prioritizes the reconstruction of fine-grained details for superior visual quality. Finally, guided by knowledge distillation, our non-uniform quantization process optimizes the quantization levels, thereby reducing storage while also compensating for quantization loss. Extensive benchmarking demonstrates our approach substantially reduces storage costs (by up to 50x compared to ECNN) while achieving superior super-resolution quality.

AI.tldr: IQ-LUT是一种创新的查找表方法，通过集成插值、量化和残差学习，在显著减小存储空间的同时提升图像超分辨率质量。
AI.motivation: 传统LUT方法在追求更高图像质量时，需要更大的感受野和位深度，这会导致索引空间呈指数级增长，造成存储瓶颈，限制了在资源受限设备上的部署。
AI.method: 1. 将插值和量化集成到单输入多输出的ECNN中，大幅减小索引空间和LUT大小；2. 集成残差学习减少对LUT位深度的依赖，提高训练稳定性并优先重建精细细节；3. 基于知识蒸馏的非均匀量化过程优化量化级别，减少存储并补偿量化损失。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法显著降低了存储成本（相比ECNN最多减少50倍），同时实现了更优的超分辨率质量。
AI.conclusion: IQ-LUT通过创新的插值-量化集成、残差学习和知识蒸馏引导的量化优化，有效解决了LUT方法的存储瓶颈问题，在资源受限设备上实现了高质量的超分辨率推理。

title: SemEval-2026 Task 9: Detecting Multilingual, Multicultural and Multievent Online Polarization
summary: We present SemEval-2026 Task 9, a shared task on online polarization detection, covering 22 languages and comprising over 110K annotated instances. Each data instance is multi-labeled with the presence of polarization, polarization type, and polarization manifestation. Participants were asked to predict labels in three sub-tasks: (1) detecting the presence of polarization, (2) identifying the type of polarization, and (3) recognizing the polarization manifestation. The three tasks attracted over 1,000 participants worldwide and more than 10k submission on Codabench. We received final submissions from 67 teams and 73 system description papers. We report the baseline results and analyze the performance of the best-performing systems, highlighting the most common approaches and the most effective methods across different subtasks and languages. The dataset of this task is publicly available.

AI.tldr: SemEval-2026 Task 9是一个关于在线极化检测的共享任务，覆盖22种语言，包含超过11万个标注实例，吸引了全球1000多名参与者和67个团队的最终提交。
AI.motivation: 随着在线内容的快速增长，识别和分析社交媒体和网络平台上的极化现象变得越来越重要。该任务旨在推动多语言极化检测技术的发展，为研究人员提供标准化的数据集和评估框架。
AI.method: 任务采用多标签标注方法，每个数据实例标注了极化存在性、极化类型和极化表现形式。参与者需要完成三个子任务：检测极化存在性、识别极化类型、识别极化表现形式。任务通过Codabench平台接收提交。
AI.result: 任务吸引了全球1000多名参与者，收到超过1万次提交，最终有67个团队提交了73篇系统描述论文。报告了基线结果并分析了最佳系统的性能，突出了不同子任务和语言中最常见和最有效的方法。
AI.conclusion: 该共享任务成功创建了一个大规模的多语言极化检测数据集，推动了该领域的研究发展。数据集已公开可用，为未来的研究提供了宝贵资源。

title: Environmental, Social and Governance Sentiment Analysis on Slovene News: A Novel Dataset and Models
comment: Accepted at the The 7th Financial Narrative Processing Workshop at LREC 26'
summary: Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) considerations are increasingly integral to assessing corporate performance, reputation, and long-term sustainability. Yet, reliable ESG ratings remain limited for smaller companies and emerging markets. We introduce the first publicly available Slovene ESG sentiment dataset and a suite of models for automatic ESG sentiment detection. The dataset, derived from the MaCoCu Slovene news collection, combines large language model (LLM)-assisted filtering with human annotation of company-related ESG content. We evaluate the performance of monolingual (SloBERTa) and multilingual (XLM-R) models, embedding-based classifiers (TabPFN), hierarchical ensemble architectures, and large language models. Results show that LLMs achieve the strongest performance on Environmental (Gemma3-27B, F1-macro: 0.61) and Social aspects (gpt-oss 20B, F1-macro: 0.45), while fine-tuned SloBERTa is the best model on Governance classification (F1-macro: 0.54). We then show in a small case study how the best-preforming classifier (gpt-oss) can be applied to investigate ESG aspects for selected companies across a long time frame.

AI.tldr: 该研究创建了首个公开的斯洛文尼亚语ESG情感数据集，并评估了多种模型在ESG情感检测任务上的表现，发现LLM在环境和社会方面表现最佳，而微调的SloBERTa在治理分类上最优。
AI.motivation: ESG因素对企业绩效、声誉和长期可持续性评估日益重要，但针对小公司和新兴市场的可靠ESG评级仍然有限，需要开发自动化的ESG情感检测工具。
AI.method: 从MaCoCu斯洛文尼亚新闻语料库创建首个公开的斯洛文尼亚语ESG情感数据集，结合LLM辅助筛选和人工标注。评估了单语（SloBERTa）、多语（XLM-R）、基于嵌入的分类器（TabPFN）、分层集成架构和大型语言模型等多种模型。
AI.result: LLM在环境（Gemma3-27B，F1-macro：0.61）和社会方面（gpt-oss 20B，F1-macro：0.45）表现最佳，而微调的SloBERTa在治理分类上最优（F1-macro：0.54）。通过案例研究展示了最佳分类器（gpt-oss）如何应用于长期分析选定公司的ESG方面。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了首个斯洛文尼亚语ESG情感数据集和有效的自动化检测方法，为小公司和新兴市场的ESG评估提供了实用工具，不同模型在不同ESG维度上各有优势。

title: WRAP++: Web discoveRy Amplified Pretraining
comment: Work in progress. Correspondence to ucaswu@tencent.com or wuxing@iie.ac.cn
summary: Synthetic data rephrasing has emerged as a powerful technique for enhancing knowledge acquisition during large language model (LLM) pretraining. However, existing approaches operate at the single-document level, rewriting individual web pages in isolation. This confines synthesized examples to intra-document knowledge, missing cross-document relationships and leaving facts with limited associative context. We propose WRAP++ (Web discoveRy Amplified Pretraining), which amplifies the associative context of factual knowledge by discovering cross-document relationships from web hyperlinks and synthesizing joint QA over each discovered document pair. Concretely, WRAP++ discovers high-confidence relational motifs including dual-links and co-mentions, and synthesizes QA that requires reasoning across both documents. This produces relational knowledge absent from either source document alone, creating diverse entry points to the same facts. Because the number of valid entity pairs grows combinatorially, this discovery-driven synthesis also amplifies data scale far beyond single-document rewriting. Instantiating WRAP++ on Wikipedia, we amplify ~8.4B tokens of raw text into 80B tokens of cross-document QA data. On SimpleQA, OLMo-based models at both 7B and 32B scales trained with WRAP++ substantially outperform single-document approaches and exhibit sustained scaling gains, underscoring the advantage of cross-document knowledge discovery and amplification.

AI.tldr: WRAP++通过发现网页超链接中的跨文档关系，合成需要跨文档推理的问答对，显著增强了LLM预训练中的知识获取能力。
AI.motivation: 现有合成数据改写方法局限于单文档层面，无法捕捉跨文档关系，导致知识缺乏关联上下文。需要一种能够发现并利用跨文档关系来增强知识获取的方法。
AI.method: WRAP++通过发现网页超链接中的高置信度关系模式（如双向链接和共同提及），为每个发现的文档对合成需要跨文档推理的联合问答对。
AI.result: 在Wikipedia上，WRAP++将约84亿token的原始文本扩增为800亿token的跨文档QA数据。在SimpleQA上，基于OLMo的7B和32B模型使用WRAP++训练后，显著优于单文档方法，并展现出持续的扩展增益。
AI.conclusion: 跨文档知识发现和扩增具有显著优势，能够生成单文档中不存在的关系知识，为相同事实创造多样化的切入点，并大幅扩增数据规模。

title: Not all tokens contribute equally to diffusion learning
summary: With the rapid development of conditional diffusion models, significant progress has been made in text-to-video generation. However, we observe that these models often neglect semantically important tokens during inference, leading to biased or incomplete generations under classifier-free guidance. We attribute this issue to two key factors: distributional bias caused by the long-tailed token frequency in training data, and spatial misalignment in cross-attention where semantically important tokens are overshadowed by less informative ones. To address these issues, we propose Distribution-Aware Rectification and Spatial Ensemble (DARE), a unified framework that improves semantic guidance in diffusion models from the perspectives of distributional debiasing and spatial consistency. First, we introduce Distribution-Rectified Classifier-Free Guidance (DR-CFG), which regularizes the training process by dynamically suppressing dominant tokens with low semantic density, encouraging the model to better capture underrepresented semantic cues and learn a more balanced conditional distribution. This design mitigates the risk of the model distribution overfitting to tokens with low semantic density. Second, we propose Spatial Representation Alignment (SRA), which adaptively reweights cross-attention maps according to token importance and enforces representation consistency, enabling semantically important tokens to exert stronger spatial guidance during generation. This mechanism effectively prevents low semantic-density tokens from dominating the attention allocation, thereby avoiding the dilution of the spatial and distributional guidance provided by high semantic-density tokens. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that DARE consistently improves generation fidelity and semantic alignment, achieving significant gains over existing approaches.

AI.tldr: DARE框架通过分布感知修正和空间集成，解决了文本到视频生成中扩散模型忽视重要语义标记的问题，提升了生成保真度和语义对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有条件扩散模型在文本到视频生成中经常忽视语义重要的标记，导致在无分类器引导下产生有偏或不完整的生成。这主要源于训练数据中标记频率的长尾分布导致的分布偏差，以及交叉注意力中空间错位问题。
AI.method: 提出了DARE统一框架，包含两个核心组件：1) 分布修正的无分类器引导(DR-CFG)，通过动态抑制低语义密度的主导标记来正则化训练过程；2) 空间表示对齐(SRA)，根据标记重要性自适应重新加权交叉注意力图并强制表示一致性。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，DARE能够持续提升生成保真度和语义对齐，相比现有方法取得了显著增益。
AI.conclusion: DARE框架通过从分布去偏和空间一致性两个角度改进扩散模型中的语义引导，有效解决了语义重要标记被忽视的问题，为文本到视频生成提供了更平衡和准确的语义控制。

title: PRISM: Rethinking Scattered Atmosphere Reconstruction as a Unified Understanding and Generation Model for Real-world Dehazing
summary: Real-world image dehazing (RID) aims to remove haze induced degradation from real scenes. This task remains challenging due to non-uniform haze distribution, spatially varying illumination from multiple light sources, and the scarcity of paired real hazy-clean data. In PRISM, we propose Proximal Scattered Atmosphere Reconstruction (PSAR), a physically structured framework that jointly reconstructs the clear scene and scattering variables under the atmospheric scattering model, thereby improving reliability in complex regions and mixed-light conditions. To bridge the synthetic-to-real gap, we design an online non-uniform haze synthesis pipeline and a Selective Self-distillation Adaptation scheme for unpaired real-world scenarios, which enables the model to selectively learn from high-quality perceptual targets while leveraging its intrinsic scattering understanding to audit residual haze and guide self-refinement. Extensive experiments on real-world benchmarks demonstrate that PRISM achieves state-of-the-art performance on RID tasks.

AI.tldr: PRISM提出了一种用于真实世界图像去雾的物理结构化框架，通过联合重建清晰场景和散射变量，结合在线非均匀雾合成和选择性自蒸馏适应方案，在真实世界基准测试中达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 真实世界图像去雾面临非均匀雾分布、多光源空间变化照明以及配对真实雾-清晰数据稀缺的挑战，现有方法在复杂区域和混合光照条件下可靠性不足。
AI.method: 提出PSAR（近端散射大气重建）物理结构化框架，在大气散射模型下联合重建清晰场景和散射变量；设计在线非均匀雾合成管道和选择性自蒸馏适应方案，使模型能够从高质量感知目标选择性学习，同时利用其内在散射理解来审计残留雾并指导自精炼。
AI.result: 在真实世界基准测试上的广泛实验表明，PRISM在真实世界图像去雾任务中实现了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: PRISM通过物理结构化建模和合成到真实域的适应策略，有效解决了真实世界图像去雾的挑战，在复杂场景和混合光照条件下表现出优越的可靠性和性能。

title: On the Step Length Confounding in LLM Reasoning Data Selection
comment: Accepted by Findings of ACL 2026. 15 pages, 9 figures. Code: https://github.com/wangbing1416/ASLEC
summary: Large reasoning models have recently demonstrated strong performance on complex tasks that require long chain-of-thought reasoning, through supervised fine-tuning on large-scale and high-quality datasets. To construct such datasets, existing pipelines generate long reasoning data from more capable Large Language Models (LLMs) and apply manually heuristic or naturalness-based selection methods to filter high-quality samples. Despite the proven effectiveness of naturalness-based data selection, which ranks data by the average log probability assigned by LLMs, our analysis shows that, when applied to LLM reasoning datasets, it systematically prefers samples with longer reasoning steps (i.e., more tokens per step) rather than higher-quality ones, a phenomenon we term step length confounding. Through quantitative analysis, we attribute this phenomenon to low-probability first tokens in reasoning steps; longer steps dilute their influence, thereby inflating the average log probabilities. To address this issue, we propose two variant methods: ASLEC-DROP, which drops first-token probabilities when computing average log probability, and ASLEC-CASL, which applies a causal debiasing regression to remove the first tokens' confounding effect. Experiments across four LLMs and five evaluation benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in mitigating the step length confounding problem.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现现有基于自然度的数据选择方法在LLM推理数据集中存在"步骤长度混淆"问题，即偏好更长推理步骤而非更高质量样本，并提出两种改进方法来解决这一问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于自然度的数据选择方法（通过LLM的平均对数概率对数据进行排序）在应用于LLM推理数据集时，系统性地偏好具有更长推理步骤的样本，而不是更高质量的样本，这种现象被称为"步骤长度混淆"。作者希望通过解决这个问题来改进推理数据集的构建质量。
AI.method: 提出了两种变体方法：1) ASLEC-DROP：在计算平均对数概率时丢弃第一个token的概率；2) ASLEC-CASL：应用因果去偏回归来消除第一个token的混淆效应。这两种方法都旨在解决步骤长度混淆问题。
AI.result: 在四个LLM和五个评估基准上的实验证明了所提方法在缓解步骤长度混淆问题方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 基于自然度的数据选择方法在LLM推理数据集中存在步骤长度混淆问题，通过丢弃第一个token的概率或应用因果去偏回归可以有效地缓解这一问题，从而提高推理数据集的质量。

title: HingeMem: Boundary Guided Long-Term Memory with Query Adaptive Retrieval for Scalable Dialogues
summary: Long-term memory is critical for dialogue systems that support continuous, sustainable, and personalized interactions. However, existing methods rely on continuous summarization or OpenIE-based graph construction paired with fixed Top-\textit{k} retrieval, leading to limited adaptability across query categories and high computational overhead. In this paper, we propose HingeMem, a boundary-guided long-term memory that operationalizes event segmentation theory to build an interpretable indexing interface via boundary-triggered hyperedges over four elements: person, time, location, and topic. When any such element changes, HingeMem draws a boundary and writes the current segment, thereby reducing redundant operations and preserving salient context. To enable robust and efficient retrieval under diverse information needs, HingeMem introduces query-adaptive retrieval mechanisms that jointly decide (a) \textit{what to retrieve}: determine the query-conditioned routing over the element-indexed memory; (b) \textit{how much to retrieve}: control the retrieval depth based on the estimated query type. Extensive experiments across LLM scales (from 0.6B to production-tier models; \textit{e.g.}, Qwen3-0.6B to Qwen-Flash) on LOCOMO show that HingeMem achieves approximately $20\%$ relative improvement over strong baselines without query categories specification, while reducing computational cost (68\%$\downarrow$ question answering token cost compared to HippoRAG2). Beyond advancing memory modeling, HingeMem's adaptive retrieval makes it a strong fit for web applications requiring efficient and trustworthy memory over extended interactions.

AI.tldr: HingeMem提出了一种基于边界触发超边的长期记忆系统，通过事件分割理论构建可解释索引接口，实现自适应检索并显著降低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 现有对话系统的长期记忆方法依赖连续摘要或OpenIE图构建配合固定Top-k检索，存在跨查询类别适应性差和计算开销大的问题，需要更高效、自适应的记忆机制。
AI.method: 基于事件分割理论，通过人物、时间、地点、话题四个元素的边界变化触发超边构建，创建可解释索引接口；引入查询自适应检索机制，联合决定检索内容和深度。
AI.result: 在LOCOMO数据集上，HingeMem相比强基线获得约20%的相对提升，无需查询类别指定；计算成本显著降低（问答token成本比HippoRAG2减少68%）。
AI.conclusion: HingeMem通过边界引导的长期记忆和自适应检索机制，在保持显著上下文的同时减少冗余操作，适用于需要高效可信记忆的Web应用，推动了记忆建模的发展。

title: Novel Anomaly Detection Scenarios and Evaluation Metrics to Address the Ambiguity in the Definition of Normal Samples
summary: In conventional anomaly detection, training data consist of only normal samples. However, in real-world scenarios, the definition of a normal sample is often ambiguous. For example, there are cases where a sample has small scratches or stains but is still acceptable for practical usage. On the other hand, higher precision is required when manufacturing equipment is upgraded. In such cases, normal samples may include small scratches, tiny dust particles, or a foreign object that we would prefer to classify as an anomaly. Such cases frequently occur in industrial settings, yet they have not been discussed until now. Thus, we propose novel scenarios and an evaluation metric to accommodate specification changes in real-world applications. Furthermore, to address the ambiguity of normal samples, we propose the RePaste, which enhances learning by re-pasting regions with high anomaly scores from the previous step into the input for the next step. On our scenarios using the MVTec AD benchmark, RePaste achieved the state-of-the-art performance with respect to the proposed evaluation metric, while maintaining high AUROC and PRO scores. Code: https://github.com/ReijiSoftmaxSaito/Scenario

AI.tldr: 提出RePaste方法解决工业异常检测中正常样本定义模糊问题，通过重新粘贴高异常分数区域来增强学习，在MVTec AD基准测试中达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 传统异常检测假设训练数据只有正常样本，但实际工业场景中正常样本定义模糊（如小划痕、微小灰尘等），且随着设备升级，对异常的精度要求会变化。现有方法未考虑这种规格变化和模糊性。
AI.method: 提出RePaste方法：在训练过程中，将前一步识别出的高异常分数区域重新粘贴到下一阶段的输入中，通过这种迭代增强学习来应对正常样本的模糊性。同时提出了适应规格变化的新场景和评估指标。
AI.result: 在MVTec AD基准测试的新场景中，RePaste在提出的评估指标上达到了最先进的性能，同时保持了高AUROC和PRO分数。
AI.conclusion: RePaste方法有效解决了工业异常检测中正常样本定义模糊的问题，提出的新场景和评估指标能更好地适应实际应用中的规格变化需求。

title: SurFITR: A Dataset for Surveillance Image Forgery Detection and Localisation
summary: We present the Surveillance Forgery Image Test Range (SurFITR), a dataset for surveillance-style image forgery detection and localisation, in response to recent advances in open-access image generation models that raise concerns about falsifying visual evidence. Existing forgery models, trained on datasets with full-image synthesis or large manipulated regions in object-centric images, struggle to generalise to surveillance scenarios. This is because tampering in surveillance imagery is typically localised and subtle, occurring in scenes with varied viewpoints, small or occluded subjects, and lower visual quality. To address this gap, SurFITR provides a large collection of forensically valuable imagery generated via a multimodal LLM-powered pipeline, enabling semantically aware, fine-grained editing across diverse surveillance scenes. It contains over 137k tampered images with varying resolutions and edit types, generated using multiple image editing models. Extensive experiments show that existing detectors degrade significantly on SurFITR, while training on SurFITR yields substantial improvements in both in-domain and cross-domain performance. SurFITR is publicly available on GitHub.

AI.tldr: SurFITR是一个专门针对监控场景的图像伪造检测数据集，解决了现有伪造检测模型在监控图像上泛化能力差的问题，包含超过13.7万张篡改图像，显著提升了检测性能。
AI.motivation: 随着开放访问图像生成模型的进步，伪造视觉证据的风险增加。现有伪造检测模型在监控场景中表现不佳，因为监控图像中的篡改通常是局部、细微的，且场景多样、主体小或被遮挡、视觉质量较低。
AI.method: 通过多模态LLM驱动的流水线生成具有法证价值的图像，实现语义感知的细粒度编辑。数据集包含超过13.7万张不同分辨率和编辑类型的篡改图像，使用多种图像编辑模型生成。
AI.result: 实验表明，现有检测器在SurFITR上性能显著下降，而在SurFITR上训练则能大幅提升域内和跨域性能。
AI.conclusion: SurFITR填补了监控图像伪造检测的数据集空白，为开发更鲁棒的伪造检测方法提供了重要资源，已在GitHub上公开可用。

title: Assessing the Added Value of Onboard Earth Observation Processing with the IRIDE HEO Service Segment
summary: Current operational Earth Observation (EO) services, including the Copernicus Emergency Management Service (CEMS), the European Forest Fire Information System (EFFIS), and the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS), rely primarily on ground-based processing pipelines. While these systems provide mature large-scale information products, they remain constrained by downlink latency, bandwidth limitations, and limited capability for autonomous observation prioritisation. The International Report for an Innovative Defence of Earth (IRIDE) programme is a national Earth observation initiative led by the Italian government to support public authorities through timely, objective information derived from spaceborne data. Rather than a single constellation, IRIDE is designed as a constellation of constellations, integrating heterogeneous sensing technologies within a unified service-oriented architecture. Within this framework, Hawk for Earth Observation (HEO) enables onboard generation of data products, allowing information extraction earlier in the processing chain. This paper examines the limitations of ground-only architectures and evaluates the added value of onboard processing at the operational service level. The IRIDE burnt-area mapping service is used as a representative case study to demonstrate how onboard intelligence can support higher spatial detail (sub-three-metre ground sampling distance), smaller detectable events (minimum mapping unit of three hectares), and improved system responsiveness. Rather than replacing existing Copernicus services, the IRIDE HEO capability is positioned as a complementary layer providing image-driven pre-classification to support downstream emergency and land-management workflows. This work highlights the operational value of onboard intelligence for emerging low-latency EO service architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了传统地面处理EO系统的局限性，评估了IRIDE项目中HEO星上处理能力的附加价值，通过火烧迹地制图案例展示了星上智能如何提升空间分辨率、事件检测能力和系统响应性。
AI.motivation: 当前EO服务（如CEMS、EFFIS、CLMS）依赖地面处理，受限于下行链路延迟、带宽限制和自主观测优先级能力不足。需要探索星上处理技术来克服这些限制，提升EO服务的响应能力和信息提取效率。
AI.method: 采用IRIDE项目的HEO（Hawk for Earth Observation）技术，实现星上数据产品生成。以IRIDE火烧迹地制图服务为案例研究，对比分析传统地面处理与星上智能处理的性能差异。
AI.result: 星上处理能力支持更高空间分辨率（亚3米地面采样距离）、更小可检测事件（最小制图单元3公顷）和改善的系统响应性。HEO作为补充层提供图像驱动的预分类，支持下游应急和土地管理工作流。
AI.conclusion: 星上智能为新兴低延迟EO服务架构提供了重要操作价值，不是替代现有哥白尼服务，而是作为补充层增强整体系统能力，特别适用于需要快速响应的应急管理和土地监测应用。

title: iTAG: Inverse Design for Natural Text Generation with Accurate Causal Graph Annotations
summary: A fundamental obstacle to causal discovery from text is the lack of causally annotated text data for use as ground truth, due to high annotation costs. This motivates an important task of generating text with causal graph annotations. Early template-based generation methods sacrifice text naturalness in exchange for high causal graph annotation accuracy. Recent Large Language Model (LLM)-dependent methods directly generate natural text from target graphs through LLMs, but do not guarantee causal graph annotation accuracy. Therefore, we propose iTAG, which performs real-world concept assignment to nodes before converting causal graphs into text in existing LLM-dependent methods. iTAG frames this process as an inverse problem with the causal graph as the target, iteratively examining and refining concept selection through Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning so that the induced relations between concepts are as consistent as possible with the target causal relationships described by the causal graph. iTAG demonstrates both extremely high annotation accuracy and naturalness across extensive tests, and the results of testing text-based causal discovery algorithms with the generated data show high statistical correlation with real-world data. This suggests that iTAG-generated data can serve as a practical surrogate for scalable benchmarking of text-based causal discovery algorithms.

AI.tldr: iTAG是一种通过迭代概念分配和CoT推理，从因果图生成高质量标注文本的新方法，平衡了文本自然性和标注准确性
AI.motivation: 文本因果发现面临缺乏因果标注文本数据的根本障碍，现有方法要么牺牲文本自然性（模板方法），要么无法保证标注准确性（LLM方法）
AI.method: iTAG将因果图转换为文本的过程视为逆问题，通过Chain-of-Thought推理迭代检查和细化概念选择，确保概念间关系与目标因果图尽可能一致
AI.result: iTAG在广泛测试中表现出极高的标注准确性和文本自然性，生成数据测试文本因果发现算法的结果与真实数据具有高度统计相关性
AI.conclusion: iTAG生成的数据可以作为文本因果发现算法可扩展基准测试的实际替代品，解决了因果标注数据稀缺的问题

title: The AI Skills Shift: Mapping Skill Obsolescence, Emergence, and Transition Pathways in the LLM Era
comment: 11 pages, 12 figures, 2 tables, 17 references. Code and data available at
summary: As Large Language Models reshape the global labor market, policymakers and workers need empirical data on which occupational skills may be most susceptible to automation. We present the Skill Automation Feasibility Index (SAFI), benchmarking four frontier LLMs -- LLaMA 3.3 70B, Mistral Large, Qwen 2.5 72B, and Gemini 2.5 Flash -- across 263 text-based tasks spanning all 35 skills in the U.S. Department of Labor's O*NET taxonomy (1,052 total model calls, 0% failure rate). Cross-referencing with real-world AI adoption data from the Anthropic Economic Index (756 occupations, 17,998 tasks), we propose an AI Impact Matrix -- an interpretive framework that positions skills along four quadrants: High Displacement Risk, Upskilling Required, AI-Augmented, and Lower Displacement Risk. Key findings: (1) Mathematics (SAFI: 73.2) and Programming (71.8) receive the highest automation feasibility scores; Active Listening (42.2) and Reading Comprehension (45.5) receive the lowest; (2) a "capability-demand inversion" where skills most demanded in AI-exposed jobs are those LLMs perform least well at in our benchmark; (3) 78.7% of observed AI interactions are augmentation, not automation; (4) all four models converge to similar skill profiles (3.6-point spread), suggesting that text-based automation feasibility may be more skill-dependent than model-dependent. SAFI measures LLM performance on text-based representations of skills, not full occupational execution. All data, code, and model responses are open-sourced.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了技能自动化可行性指数(SAFI)，评估了4个前沿LLM在263个文本任务上的表现，发现数学和编程技能最易自动化，而主动倾听和阅读理解最难自动化，78.7%的AI交互是增强而非替代。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型重塑全球劳动力市场，政策制定者和工作者需要关于哪些职业技能最易受自动化影响的实证数据，以制定相应的应对策略。
AI.method: 提出SAFI指数，对4个前沿LLM（LLaMA 3.3 70B、Mistral Large、Qwen 2.5 72B、Gemini 2.5 Flash）在263个基于文本的任务上进行基准测试，涵盖美国劳工部O*NET分类中的35项技能，共进行1,052次模型调用。结合Anthropic经济指数的真实世界AI采用数据，提出AI影响矩阵分析框架。
AI.result: 1. 数学(73.2)和编程(71.8)自动化可行性最高，主动倾听(42.2)和阅读理解(45.5)最低；2. 存在"能力-需求倒置"现象；3. 78.7%的AI交互是增强而非自动化；4. 四个模型在技能评估上表现相似(3.6分差)，表明文本自动化可行性更多取决于技能本身而非模型。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了技能自动化可行性的实证基准，发现AI更多是增强而非替代人类工作，技能特性比模型选择对自动化可行性影响更大，为政策制定和职业规划提供了数据支持。

title: CSA-Graphs: A Privacy-Preserving Structural Dataset for Child Sexual Abuse Research
comment: Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR 2026), in the Workshop on Computer Vision for Children (CV4CHL)
summary: Child Sexual Abuse Imagery (CSAI) classification is an important yet challenging problem for computer vision research due to the strict legal and ethical restrictions that prevent the public sharing of CSAI datasets. This limitation hinders reproducibility and slows progress in developing automated methods. In this work, we introduce CSA-Graphs, a privacy-preserving structural dataset. Instead of releasing the original images, we provide structural representations that remove explicit visual content while preserving contextual information. CSA-Graphs includes two complementary graph-based modalities: scene graphs describing object relationships and skeleton graphs encoding human pose. Experiments show that both representations retain useful information for classifying CSAI, and that combining them further improves performance. This dataset enables broader research on computer vision methods for child safety while respecting legal and ethical constraints.

AI.tldr: 提出了CSA-Graphs数据集，通过隐私保护的结构化表示（场景图和骨架图）替代原始图像，解决儿童性虐待图像分类研究中数据共享的法律伦理限制问题。
AI.motivation: 儿童性虐待图像分类研究面临严格的法律伦理限制，无法公开共享原始数据集，这阻碍了研究的可重复性和自动化方法的发展进度。
AI.method: 创建CSA-Graphs隐私保护结构化数据集，提供两种互补的图表示：描述物体关系的场景图和编码人体姿态的骨架图，移除显式视觉内容但保留上下文信息。
AI.result: 实验表明两种图表示都保留了用于CSAI分类的有用信息，且组合使用能进一步提升性能。
AI.conclusion: CSA-Graphs数据集能够在尊重法律伦理约束的同时，促进儿童安全计算机视觉方法的更广泛研究。

title: ChunQiuTR: Time-Keyed Temporal Retrieval in Classical Chinese Annals
comment: 24 pages, 11 figures. To appear in Findings of ACL 2026
summary: Retrieval shapes how language models access and ground knowledge in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). In historical research, the target is often not an arbitrary relevant passage, but the exact record for a specific regnal month, where temporal consistency matters as much as topical relevance. This is especially challenging for Classical Chinese annals, where time is expressed through terse, implicit, non-Gregorian reign phrases that must be interpreted from surrounding context, so semantically plausible evidence can still be temporally invalid. We introduce \textbf{ChunQiuTR}, a time-keyed retrieval benchmark built from the \textit{Spring and Autumn Annals} and its exegetical tradition. ChunQiuTR organizes records by month-level reign keys and includes chrono-near confounders that mirror realistic retrieval failures. We further propose \textbf{CTD} (Calendrical Temporal Dual-encoder), a time-aware dual-encoder that combines Fourier-based absolute calendrical context with relative offset biasing. Experiments show consistent gains over strong semantic dual-encoder baselines under time-keyed evaluation, supporting retrieval-time temporal consistency as a key prerequisite for faithful downstream historical RAG. Our code and datasets are available at \href{https://github.com/xbdxwyh/ChunQiuTR}{\texttt{github.com/xbdxwyh/ChunQiuTR}}.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了ChunQiuTR时间键控检索基准和CTD时间感知双编码器，用于解决历史研究中检索增强生成的时间一致性问题，特别是在处理非公历纪年的古典中文编年史时。
AI.motivation: 在历史研究中，检索的目标通常不是任意相关段落，而是特定统治月份的确切记录，时间一致性至关重要。古典中文编年史使用简洁、隐式、非公历的统治短语表达时间，需要从上下文解读，这导致语义上合理的证据可能在时间上无效。
AI.method: 提出了ChunQiuTR时间键控检索基准，基于《春秋》及其注释传统构建，按月份级统治键组织记录，包含反映实际检索失败的时序近邻混淆项。进一步提出了CTD（历法时间双编码器），结合基于傅里叶的绝对历法上下文和相对偏移偏置的时间感知双编码器。
AI.result: 实验显示，在时间键控评估下，CTD相比强大的语义双编码器基线获得了一致的性能提升，支持检索时的时间一致性作为忠实下游历史RAG的关键前提。
AI.conclusion: 检索时的时间一致性对于历史检索增强生成至关重要，特别是在处理古典中文编年史等时间表达隐式的文本时。提出的ChunQiuTR基准和CTD方法为解决这一问题提供了有效工具。

title: Learning to Search: A Decision-Based Agent for Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering
summary: Knowledge-based visual question answering (KB-VQA) requires vision-language models to understand images and use external knowledge, especially for rare entities and long-tail facts. Most existing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) methods adopt a fixed pipeline that sequentially retrieves information, filters it, and then produces an answer. Such a design makes it difficult to adapt to diverse question types. Moreover, it separates retrieval from reasoning, making it hard for the model to decide when to search, how to refine queries, or when to stop. As a result, the retrieved evidence is often poorly aligned with the question. To address these limitations, we reformulate KB-VQA as a search-agent problem and model the solving process as a multi-step decision-making procedure. At each step, the agent selects one of four actions-Answer, Image Retrieval, Text Retrieval, and Caption-based on its current information state. We further design an automated pipeline to collect multi-step trajectories that record the agent's reasoning process, tool usage, and intermediate decisions. These trajectories are then used as supervision for fine-tuning. Experiments on InfoSeek and E-VQA demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, consistently outperforming prior baselines and confirming the effectiveness of our framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将知识库视觉问答重新定义为搜索代理问题的方法，通过多步决策过程让代理自主选择检索、回答等动作，显著提升了模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有检索增强生成方法采用固定流水线设计，难以适应多样化问题类型，且将检索与推理分离，导致检索证据与问题对齐不佳。需要更灵活的方法来改善知识库视觉问答的性能。
AI.method: 将KB-VQA重新定义为搜索代理问题，建模为多步决策过程。代理在每一步从四种动作中选择：回答、图像检索、文本检索、图像描述。设计自动化流水线收集多步轨迹记录推理过程，并用于微调监督。
AI.result: 在InfoSeek和E-VQA数据集上的实验表明，该方法达到了最先进的性能，持续优于先前基线，验证了框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将KB-VQA重新定义为搜索代理问题，通过多步决策过程让模型自主决定何时检索、如何优化查询以及何时停止，显著改善了检索证据与问题的对齐，提升了整体性能。

title: Continuous Interpretive Steering for Scalar Diversity
summary: Pragmatic inference is inherently graded. Different lexical items give rise to pragmatic enrichment to different degrees. Scalar implicature exemplifies this property through scalar diversity, where implicature strength varies across scalar items. However, evaluations of pragmatic inference in large language models (LLMs) often rely on prompt-based manipulations. Beyond prompt-level effects, this study introduces Continuous Interpretive Steering (CIS), a method that probes graded pragmatic interpretation by treating activation-level steering strength as a continuous experimental variable. To support this analysis, this study introduces a new dataset, GraSD, which encodes graded scalar diversity. Experiments on four LLMs show that uniform activation steering increases pragmatic interpretations globally but collapses item-level variation, whereas graded activation steering yields differentiated interpretive shifts aligned with scalar diversity grades. It indicates that graded sensitivity is encoded in the representation space and can be systematically recovered through controlled intervention. Together, CIS and GraSD provide a principled framework for evaluating graded pragmatic sensitivity in LLMs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出连续解释性引导(CIS)方法和GraSD数据集，用于评估大语言模型中分级语用推理能力，发现均匀激活引导会破坏项目级差异，而分级引导能恢复与标量多样性等级一致的差异化解释偏移。
AI.motivation: 语用推理本质上是分级的，不同词汇项产生不同程度的语用充实。标量含义通过标量多样性体现了这一特性，其中含义强度在不同标量项间变化。然而，当前对大语言模型中语用推理的评估通常依赖基于提示的操作，需要超越提示层面的方法来探究分级语用解释。
AI.method: 本研究引入连续解释性引导(CIS)方法，通过将激活级引导强度作为连续实验变量来探测分级语用解释。同时创建了GraSD数据集，该数据集编码了分级标量多样性。在四个大语言模型上进行实验，比较均匀激活引导和分级激活引导的效果。
AI.result: 实验表明，均匀激活引导虽然能全局增加语用解释，但会破坏项目级变化；而分级激活引导能产生与标量多样性等级一致的差异化解释偏移。这表明分级敏感性在表示空间中被编码，并能通过受控干预系统性地恢复。
AI.conclusion: CIS方法和GraSD数据集为评估大语言模型中的分级语用敏感性提供了一个原则性框架，揭示了语用推理的分级特性在模型表示中的编码方式，以及如何通过精细的激活引导来恢复这种分级敏感性。

title: DTCRS: Dynamic Tree Construction for Recursive Summarization
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) mitigates the hallucination problem of Large Language Models (LLMs) by incorporating external knowledge. Recursive summarization constructs a hierarchical summary tree by clustering text chunks, integrating information from multiple parts of a document to provide evidence for abstractive questions involving multi-step reasoning. However, summary trees often contain a large number of redundant summary nodes, which not only increase construction time but may also negatively impact question answering. Moreover, recursive summarization is not suitable for all types of questions. We introduce DTCRS, a method that dynamically generates summary trees based on document structure and query semantics. DTCRS determines whether a summary tree is necessary by analyzing the question type. It then decomposes the question and uses the embeddings of sub-questions as initial cluster centers, reducing redundant summaries while improving the relevance between summaries and the question. Our approach significantly reduces summary tree construction time and achieves substantial improvements across three QA tasks. Additionally, we investigate the applicability of recursive summarization to different question types, providing valuable insights for future research.

AI.tldr: DTCRS是一种动态生成摘要树的方法，通过分析问题类型和文档结构，减少冗余摘要节点，提高问答性能
AI.motivation: 传统递归摘要方法存在两个主要问题：1) 摘要树包含大量冗余节点，增加构建时间且可能影响问答性能；2) 递归摘要并非适用于所有类型的问题。需要一种更智能的方法来动态决定是否使用摘要树，并优化摘要生成过程。
AI.method: DTCRS方法包含三个关键步骤：1) 通过分析问题类型动态决定是否需要构建摘要树；2) 将问题分解为子问题，使用子问题的嵌入向量作为初始聚类中心；3) 基于文档结构和查询语义动态生成摘要树，减少冗余摘要节点。
AI.result: DTCRS显著减少了摘要树构建时间，并在三个问答任务上取得了实质性改进。同时，研究还探讨了递归摘要对不同问题类型的适用性，为未来研究提供了有价值的见解。
AI.conclusion: DTCRS通过动态决策和优化摘要生成过程，有效解决了传统递归摘要方法的冗余问题，提高了RAG系统的效率和性能，并为递归摘要的应用范围提供了理论指导。

title: DINO-QPM: Adapting Visual Foundation Models for Globally Interpretable Image Classification
comment: Accepted to the 5th Explainable AI for Computer Vision (XAI4CV) Workshop at CVPR 2026
summary: Although visual foundation models like DINOv2 provide state-of-the-art performance as feature extractors, their complex, high-dimensional representations create substantial hurdles for interpretability. This work proposes DINO-QPM, which converts these powerful but entangled features into contrastive, class-independent representations that are interpretable by humans. DINO-QPM is a lightweight interpretability adapter that pursues globally interpretable image classification, adapting the Quadratic Programming Enhanced Model (QPM) to operate on strictly frozen DINO backbones. While classification with visual foundation models typically relies on the \texttt{CLS} token, we deliberately diverge from this standard. By leveraging average-pooling, we directly connect the patch embeddings to the model's features and therefore enable spatial localisation of DINO-QPM's globally interpretable features within the input space. Furthermore, we apply a sparsity loss to minimise spatial scatter and background noise, ensuring that explanations are grounded in relevant object parts. With DINO-QPM we make the level of interpretability of QPM available as an adapter while exceeding the accuracy of DINOv2 linear probe. Evaluated through an introduced Plausibility metric and other interpretability metrics, extensive experiments demonstrate that DINO-QPM is superior to other applicable methods for frozen visual foundation models in both classification accuracy and explanation quality.

AI.tldr: DINO-QPM是一种轻量级可解释性适配器，将DINOv2等视觉基础模型的复杂特征转换为可对比、类别无关的可解释表示，同时保持高分类精度。
AI.motivation: 尽管DINOv2等视觉基础模型作为特征提取器性能卓越，但其复杂的高维表示给可解释性带来了重大障碍。需要将这些强大但纠缠的特征转换为人类可解释的形式。
AI.method: 提出DINO-QPM轻量级可解释性适配器，将QPM（二次规划增强模型）适配到严格冻结的DINO骨干网络上。不使用标准的CLS令牌，而是通过平均池化直接连接补丁嵌入到模型特征，实现空间定位。应用稀疏损失最小化空间散射和背景噪声，确保解释基于相关物体部分。
AI.result: DINO-QPM在保持QPM可解释性水平的同时，超过了DINOv2线性探测的准确率。通过新引入的Plausibility指标和其他可解释性指标评估，在分类准确率和解释质量上都优于其他适用于冻结视觉基础模型的方法。
AI.conclusion: DINO-QPM成功地将视觉基础模型的强大特征转换为可解释表示，实现了全局可解释的图像分类，同时保持了高性能，为复杂视觉模型的可解释性提供了有效解决方案。

title: Corpora deduplication or duplication in Natural Language Processing of few resourced languages ? A case of study: The Mexico's Nahuatl
summary: In this article, we seek to answer the following question: could data duplication be useful in Natural Language Processing (NLP) for languages with limited computational resources? In this type of languages (or $π$-languages), corpora available for training Large Language Models are virtually non-existent. In particular, we will study the impact of corpora expansion in Nawatl, an agglutinative and polysynthetic $π$-language spoken by over 2 million people, with a large number of dialectal varieties. The aim is to expand the new $π$-yalli corpus, which contains a limited number of Nawatl texts, by duplicating it in a controlled way. In our experiments, we will use the incremental duplication technique. The aim is to learn embeddings that are well-suited to NLP tasks. Thus, static embeddings were trained and evaluated in a sentence-level semantic similarity task. Our results show a moderate improvement in performance when using incremental duplication compared to the results obtained using only the corpus without expansion. Furthermore, to our knowledge, this technique has not yet been used in the literature.

AI.tldr: 研究数据复制对资源有限语言NLP是否有用，通过增量复制技术扩展Nawatl语料库，在语义相似度任务中获得了中等性能提升。
AI.motivation: 针对计算资源有限的语言（π-语言），如Nawatl语，可用的训练语料库几乎不存在。研究数据复制是否能在这种语言环境下提升NLP任务性能。
AI.method: 使用增量复制技术扩展π-yalli语料库，通过受控方式复制有限的Nawatl文本。训练静态词嵌入并在句子级语义相似度任务中进行评估。
AI.result: 与未扩展的语料库相比，使用增量复制技术获得了中等程度的性能提升。该技术在文献中尚未被使用过。
AI.conclusion: 数据复制对资源有限语言的NLP任务具有潜在价值，增量复制技术能有效提升模型性能，为π-语言处理提供了新思路。

title: Multiple Domain Generalization Using Category Information Independent of Domain Differences
summary: Domain generalization is a technique aimed at enabling models to maintain high accuracy when applied to new environments or datasets (unseen domains) that differ from the datasets used in training. Generally, the accuracy of models trained on a specific dataset (source domain) often decreases significantly when evaluated on different datasets (target domain). This issue arises due to differences in domains caused by varying environmental conditions such as imaging equipment and staining methods. Therefore, we undertook two initiatives to perform segmentation that does not depend on domain differences. We propose a method that separates category information independent of domain differences from the information specific to the source domain. By using information independent of domain differences, our method enables learning the segmentation targets (e.g., blood vessels and cell nuclei). Although we extract independent information of domain differences, this cannot completely bridge the domain gap between training and test data. Therefore, we absorb the domain gap using the quantum vectors in Stochastically Quantized Variational AutoEncoder (SQ-VAE). In experiments, we evaluated our method on datasets for vascular segmentation and cell nucleus segmentation. Our methods improved the accuracy compared to conventional methods.

AI.tldr: 提出一种域泛化方法，通过分离与域差异无关的类别信息和源域特定信息，结合SQ-VAE的量子向量吸收域间差异，提升血管和细胞核分割的跨域准确性。
AI.motivation: 模型在特定数据集（源域）上训练后，在不同数据集（目标域）上评估时准确性显著下降，这是由于成像设备和染色方法等环境条件差异导致的域差异问题。因此需要开发不依赖域差异的分割方法。
AI.method: 1. 分离与域差异无关的类别信息和源域特定信息；2. 利用域差异无关信息学习分割目标（血管和细胞核）；3. 使用SQ-VAE的量子向量吸收训练和测试数据之间的域差异。
AI.result: 在血管分割和细胞核分割数据集上的实验表明，该方法相比传统方法提高了准确性。
AI.conclusion: 通过分离域差异无关信息和利用SQ-VAE量子向量吸收域差异，实现了更好的域泛化分割性能，在跨域医学图像分割任务中表现出优势。

title: MARS: Enabling Autoregressive Models Multi-Token Generation
summary: Autoregressive (AR) language models generate text one token at a time, even when consecutive tokens are highly predictable given earlier context. We introduce MARS (Mask AutoRegreSsion), a lightweight fine-tuning method that teaches an instruction-tuned AR model to predict multiple tokens per forward pass. MARS adds no architectural modifications, no extra parameters, and produces a single model that can still be called exactly like the original AR model with no performance degradation. Unlike speculative decoding, which maintains a separate draft model alongside the target, or multi-head approaches such as Medusa, which attach additional prediction heads, MARS requires only continued training on existing instruction data. When generating one token per forward pass, MARS matches or exceeds the AR baseline on six standard benchmarks. When allowed to accept multiple tokens per step, it maintains baseline-level accuracy while achieving 1.5-1.7x throughput. We further develop a block-level KV caching strategy for batch inference, achieving up to 1.71x wall-clock speedup over AR with KV cache on Qwen2.5-7B. Finally, MARS supports real-time speed adjustment via confidence thresholding: under high request load, the serving system can increase throughput on the fly without swapping models or restarting, providing a practical latency-quality knob for deployment.

AI.tldr: MARS是一种轻量级微调方法，让自回归语言模型能一次预测多个token，无需修改架构或增加参数，保持与原模型相同接口，在保持准确性的同时提升1.5-1.7倍吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 自回归语言模型每次只生成一个token，即使后续token在给定上下文后高度可预测，这种逐token生成方式限制了推理效率。现有方法如推测解码需要额外模型，多头方法需要附加预测头，都增加了复杂性。
AI.method: MARS通过轻量级微调教导指令调优的自回归模型在一次前向传播中预测多个token。方法不修改架构、不增加参数，仅需在现有指令数据上继续训练。支持块级KV缓存策略和基于置信度阈值的实时速度调整。
AI.result: 在六个标准基准测试中，一次生成一个token时MARS匹配或超过自回归基线。允许每步接受多个token时，保持基线级准确性同时实现1.5-1.7倍吞吐量。在Qwen2.5-7B上使用KV缓存实现最高1.71倍加速。
AI.conclusion: MARS提供了一种实用的延迟-质量权衡机制，支持实时速度调整，无需更换模型或重启，为部署提供了灵活的效率优化方案，在保持模型接口和性能的同时显著提升推理速度。

title: Energy-based Tissue Manifolds for Longitudinal Multiparametric MRI Analysis
comment: The code is available at https://github.com/tkartikay/EnFold-MRI
summary: We propose a geometric framework for longitudinal multi-parametric MRI analysis based on patient-specific energy modelling in sequence space. Rather than operating on images with spatial networks, each voxel is represented by its multi-sequence intensity vector ($T1$, $T1c$, $T2$, FLAIR, ADC), and a compact implicit neural representation is trained via denoising score matching to learn an energy function $E_θ(\mathbf{u})$ over $\mathbb{R}^d$ from a single baseline scan. The learned energy landscape provides a differential-geometric description of tissue regimes without segmentation labels. Local minima define tissue basins, gradient magnitude reflects proximity to regime boundaries, and Laplacian curvature characterises local constraint structure. Importantly, this baseline energy manifold is treated as a fixed geometric reference: it encodes the set of contrast combinations observed at diagnosis and is not retrained at follow-up. Longitudinal assessment is therefore formulated as evaluation of subsequent scans relative to this baseline geometry. Rather than comparing anatomical segmentations, we analyse how the distribution of MRI sequence vectors evolves under the baseline energy function. In a paediatric case with later recurrence, follow-up scans show progressive deviation in energy and directional displacement in sequence space toward the baseline tumour-associated regime before clear radiological reappearance. In a case with stable disease, voxel distributions remain confined to established low-energy basins without systematic drift. The presented cases serve as proof-of-concept that patient-specific energy manifolds can function as geometric reference systems for longitudinal mpMRI analysis without explicit segmentation or supervised classification, providing a foundation for further investigation of manifold-based tissue-at-risk tracking in neuro-oncology.

AI.tldr: 提出基于患者特异性能量建模的纵向多参数MRI几何分析框架，通过去噪分数匹配学习序列空间的能量函数，将基线扫描作为固定几何参考，用于评估后续扫描的演变。
AI.motivation: 传统纵向MRI分析依赖空间网络和图像分割，需要大量标注数据。本文旨在开发无需分割标签的几何框架，通过能量建模在序列空间直接分析组织状态演变。
AI.method: 将每个体素表示为多序列强度向量，通过去噪分数匹配训练紧凑的隐式神经表示学习能量函数。基线扫描的能量流形作为固定几何参考，后续扫描通过在该能量函数下的分布演变进行评估。
AI.result: 在儿科复发案例中，随访扫描显示能量逐渐偏离，序列空间方向位移向基线肿瘤相关区域；在稳定疾病案例中，体素分布保持在低能量盆地内。证明患者特异性能量流形可作为纵向分析的几何参考系统。
AI.conclusion: 患者特异性能量流形能够作为无需显式分割或监督分类的纵向mpMRI分析几何参考系统，为神经肿瘤学中基于流形的组织风险追踪研究奠定基础。

title: Gemma 4, Phi-4, and Qwen3: Accuracy-Efficiency Tradeoffs in Dense and MoE Reasoning Language Models
summary: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models are often expected to offer better quality-efficiency tradeoffs than dense models because only a subset of parameters is activated per token, but the practical value of that advantage depends on end-to-end behavior under realistic inference constraints. We present a controlled empirical benchmark of seven recent reasoning-oriented instruction-tuned models spanning dense and MoE designs, namely Gemma-4-E2B, Gemma-4-E4B, Gemma-4-26B-A4B, Phi-4-mini-reasoning, Phi-4-reasoning, Qwen3-8B, and Qwen3-30B-A3B, evaluated on four benchmarks -- ARC-Challenge, GSM8K, Math Level 1-3, and TruthfulQA MC1 -- under three prompting strategies: zero-shot, chain-of-thought, and few-shot chain-of-thought. The study covers 8,400 total model-dataset-prompt evaluations and records accuracy, latency, peak GPU memory usage (VRAM), and an approximate floating-point operations (FLOPs)-per-token proxy. Across the weighted multi-task summary, Gemma-4-E4B with few-shot chain-of-thought achieved the best overall result, reaching weighted accuracy 0.675 with mean VRAM 14.9 GB, while Gemma-4-26B-A4B was close in accuracy at 0.663 but substantially more memory intensive at 48.1 GB. At the task level, Gemma models dominated ARC and Math, Phi models were strongest on TruthfulQA, and GSM8K showed the largest prompt sensitivity, including a sharp drop for Phi-4-reasoning from 0.67 under chain-of-thought to 0.11 under few-shot chain-of-thought. These results show that sparse activation alone does not guarantee the best practical operating point: observed accuracy-efficiency tradeoffs depend jointly on architecture, prompting protocol, and task composition. We release a reproducible benchmark pipeline, aggregated results, and paired statistical analyses to support deployment-oriented evaluation of reasoning LLMs under real resource constraints.

AI.tldr: 对7个推理导向的指令调优模型（包括稠密和MoE架构）在4个基准测试和3种提示策略下的综合评估，发现Gemma-4-E4B在few-shot链式思维下获得最佳整体表现，稀疏激活本身不能保证最佳实用效果。
AI.motivation: 研究MoE语言模型在实际推理约束下的端到端行为，验证稀疏激活是否真正提供比稠密模型更好的质量-效率权衡，为部署导向的推理LLM评估提供实证基准。
AI.method: 构建受控实证基准，评估7个推理导向的指令调优模型（Gemma-4-E2B、Gemma-4-E4B、Gemma-4-26B-A4B、Phi-4-mini-reasoning、Phi-4-reasoning、Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-30B-A3B），在4个基准测试（ARC-Challenge、GSM8K、Math Level 1-3、TruthfulQA MC1）和3种提示策略（zero-shot、chain-of-thought、few-shot chain-of-thought）下的表现，记录准确率、延迟、峰值GPU内存使用和FLOPs-per-token代理指标。
AI.result: 总共8,400次模型-数据集-提示评估显示：Gemma-4-E4B在few-shot链式思维下获得最佳加权多任务汇总结果（准确率0.675，平均VRAM 14.9GB）；Gemma-4-26B-A4B准确率接近（0.663）但内存消耗显著更高（48.1GB）；Gemma模型在ARC和Math上表现最佳，Phi模型在TruthfulQA上最强，GSM8K显示最大的提示敏感性，特别是Phi-4-reasoning从链式思维的0.67急剧下降到few-shot链式思维的0.11。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏激活本身不能保证最佳实用操作点，观察到的准确率-效率权衡共同取决于架构、提示协议和任务组成。研究提供了可复现的基准管道、汇总结果和配对统计分析，支持在真实资源约束下对推理LLM进行部署导向的评估。

title: TeaLeafVision: An Explainable and Robust Deep Learning Framework for Tea Leaf Disease Classification
summary: As the worlds second most consumed beverage after water, tea is not just a cultural staple but a global economic force of profound scale and influence. More than a mere drink, it represents a quiet negotiation between nature, culture, and the human desire for a moment of reflection. So, the precise identification and detection of tea leaf disease is crucial. With this goal, we have evaluated several Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) models, among them three shows noticeable performance including DenseNet201, MobileNetV2, InceptionV3 on the teaLeafBD dataset. teaLeafBD dataset contains seven classes, six disease classes and one healthy class, collected under various field conditions reflecting real world challenges. Among the CNN models, DenseNet201 has achieved the highest test accuracy of 99%. In order to enhance the model reliability and interpretability, we have implemented Gradient weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad CAM), occlusion sensitivity analysis and adversarial training techniques to increase the noise resistance of the model. Finally, we have developed a prototype in order to leverage the models capabilities on real life agriculture. This paper illustrates the deep learning models capabilities to classify the disease in real life tea leaf disease detection and management.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了多种CNN模型在茶叶病害检测上的性能，其中DenseNet201在teaLeafBD数据集上取得了99%的最高测试准确率，并采用Grad-CAM、遮挡敏感度分析和对抗训练等技术增强模型可靠性和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 茶叶作为全球第二大消费饮料，其病害的精确识别和检测对茶叶产业至关重要。研究旨在利用深度学习技术解决茶叶病害检测这一实际问题，帮助茶叶种植者进行病害管理和防治。
AI.method: 研究评估了多种卷积神经网络模型（包括DenseNet201、MobileNetV2、InceptionV3）在teaLeafBD数据集上的性能。该数据集包含7个类别（6种病害和1种健康叶片），采集于多种田间条件以反映真实世界挑战。采用Grad-CAM进行可视化解释，进行遮挡敏感度分析，并实施对抗训练以提高模型的抗噪能力。
AI.result: 在评估的CNN模型中，DenseNet201表现最佳，达到了99%的最高测试准确率。研究还开发了一个原型系统，将模型能力应用于实际农业场景，展示了深度学习在茶叶病害检测和管理中的实用价值。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了深度学习模型在茶叶病害检测中的有效性，特别是DenseNet201模型在teaLeafBD数据集上表现出色。通过可解释性技术和对抗训练增强了模型的可靠性和鲁棒性，为实际农业应用提供了可行的解决方案。

title: ReDAct: Uncertainty-Aware Deferral for LLM Agents
summary: Recently, LLM-based agents have become increasingly popular across many applications, including complex sequential decision-making problems. However, they inherit the tendency of LLMs to hallucinate, leading to incorrect decisions. In sequential settings, even a single mistake can irreversibly degrade the trajectory, making hallucinations an even bigger problem. Although larger LLMs hallucinate less, they incur a significantly higher per-token cost. In this paper, we address this tradeoff by proposing ReDAct (Reason-Defer-Act). In ReDAct, an agent is equipped with two LLMs: a small, cheap model used by default, and a large, more reliable but expensive model. When the predictive uncertainty of the small model exceeds a calibrated threshold, the decision is deferred to the large model. We evaluate our approach in text-based embodied environments such as ALFWorld and MiniGrid and show that deferring only about 15% of decisions to the large model can match the quality of using it exclusively, while significantly reducing inference costs.

AI.tldr: ReDAct框架使用大小模型组合，通过不确定性阈值将约15%决策交给大模型，在保持性能的同时显著降低推理成本
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在序列决策中容易产生幻觉，单个错误可能导致整个轨迹不可逆地恶化。虽然大模型幻觉较少，但推理成本显著更高，需要在性能与成本之间寻找平衡
AI.method: 提出ReDAct（Reason-Defer-Act）框架，配备两个LLM：默认使用小型廉价模型，当小模型预测不确定性超过校准阈值时，将决策推迟给大型可靠但昂贵的模型
AI.result: 在ALFWorld和MiniGrid等文本化具身环境中评估，仅将约15%的决策推迟给大模型，就能达到完全使用大模型的性能水平，同时显著降低推理成本
AI.conclusion: ReDAct框架通过智能地在小模型和大模型之间切换，有效解决了LLM智能体在序列决策中的幻觉问题与成本权衡，为实际部署提供了经济高效的解决方案

title: Sell More, Play Less: Benchmarking LLM Realistic Selling Skill
summary: Sales dialogues require multi-turn, goal-directed persuasion under asymmetric incentives, which makes them a challenging setting for large language models (LLMs). Yet existing dialogue benchmarks rarely measure deal progression and outcomes. We introduce SalesLLM, a bilingual (ZH/EN) benchmark derived from realistic applications covering Financial Services and Consumer Goods, built from 30,074 scripted configurations and 1,805 curated multi-turn scenarios with controllable difficulty and personas. We propose a fully automatic evaluation pipeline that combines (i) an LLM-based rater for sales-process progress, and (ii) fine-tuned BERT classifiers for end-of-dialogue buying intent. To improve simulation fidelity, we train a user model, CustomerLM, with SFT and DPO on 8,000 crowdworker-involved sales conversations, reducing role inversion from 17.44% (GPT-4o) to 8.8%. SalesLLM scores correlate strongly with expert human ratings (Pearson r=0.98). Experiments across 15 mainstream LLMs reveal substantial variability: top-performance LLMs are competitive with human-level performance while the less capable ones are worse than human. SalesLLM serves as a scalable benchmark for developing and evaluating outcome-oriented sales agents.

AI.tldr: SalesLLM是一个用于评估销售对话AI的双语基准测试，包含金融服务和消费品领域的真实场景，通过自动评估管道测量交易进展和购买意图。
AI.motivation: 销售对话具有多轮、目标导向的说服特点，且存在不对称激励，这对大语言模型构成挑战。现有对话基准很少测量交易进展和结果，需要专门针对销售场景的评估工具。
AI.method: 构建SalesLLM双语基准，包含30,074个脚本配置和1,805个多轮场景，具有可控难度和角色设定。提出自动评估管道：使用LLM评估销售过程进展，微调BERT分类器评估购买意图。训练用户模型CustomerLM，通过SFT和DPO在8,000个众包销售对话上训练，提高模拟真实性。
AI.result: SalesLLM评分与专家人工评分高度相关（Pearson r=0.98）。CustomerLM将角色反转率从GPT-4o的17.44%降低到8.8%。在15个主流LLM上的实验显示性能差异显著：表现最好的LLM与人类水平相当，而能力较差的模型表现不如人类。
AI.conclusion: SalesLLM作为一个可扩展的基准，可用于开发和评估面向结果的销售代理，填补了现有对话基准在测量交易进展和结果方面的空白。

title: VersaVogue: Visual Expert Orchestration and Preference Alignment for Unified Fashion Synthesis
summary: Diffusion models have driven remarkable advancements in fashion image generation, yet prior works usually treat garment generation and virtual dressing as separate problems, limiting their flexibility in real-world fashion workflows. Moreover, fashion image synthesis under multi-source heterogeneous conditions remains challenging, as existing methods typically rely on simple feature concatenation or static layer-wise injection, which often causes attribute entanglement and semantic interference. To address these issues, we propose VersaVogue, a unified framework for multi-condition controllable fashion synthesis that jointly supports garment generation and virtual dressing, corresponding to the design and showcase stages of the fashion lifecycle. Specifically, we introduce a trait-routing attention (TA) module that leverages a mixture-of-experts mechanism to dynamically route condition features to the most compatible experts and generative layers, enabling disentangled injection of visual attributes such as texture, shape, and color. To further improve realism and controllability, we develop an automated multi-perspective preference optimization (MPO) pipeline that constructs preference data without human annotation or task-specific reward models. By combining evaluators of content fidelity, textual alignment, and perceptual quality, MPO identifies reliable preference pairs, which are then used to optimize the model via direct preference optimization (DPO). Extensive experiments on both garment generation and virtual dressing benchmarks demonstrate that VersaVogue consistently outperforms existing methods in visual fidelity, semantic consistency, and fine-grained controllability.

AI.tldr: VersaVogue是一个统一的多条件可控时尚合成框架，支持服装生成和虚拟试衣，通过特质路由注意力模块和自动化多视角偏好优化提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型通常将服装生成和虚拟试衣视为独立问题，限制了实际时尚工作流的灵活性。同时，多源异构条件下的时尚图像合成面临挑战，现有方法依赖简单的特征拼接或静态层注入，导致属性纠缠和语义干扰。
AI.method: 提出特质路由注意力模块，利用专家混合机制动态路由条件特征到最兼容的专家和生成层，实现纹理、形状、颜色等视觉属性的解耦注入。开发自动化多视角偏好优化流程，结合内容保真度、文本对齐和感知质量评估器构建偏好数据，通过直接偏好优化优化模型。
AI.result: 在服装生成和虚拟试衣基准测试上的广泛实验表明，VersaVogue在视觉保真度、语义一致性和细粒度可控性方面持续优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: VersaVogue提供了一个统一的框架，能够同时支持时尚生命周期的设计和展示阶段，通过动态条件注入和自动化偏好优化解决了多条件时尚合成的关键挑战。

title: IndoBERT-Sentiment: Context-Conditioned Sentiment Classification for Indonesian Text
summary: Existing Indonesian sentiment analysis models classify text in isolation, ignoring the topical context that often determines whether a statement is positive, negative, or neutral. We introduce IndoBERT-Sentiment, a context-conditioned sentiment classifier that takes both a topical context and a text as input, producing sentiment predictions grounded in the topic being discussed. Built on IndoBERT Large (335M parameters) and trained on 31,360 context-text pairs labeled across 188 topics, the model achieves an F1 macro of 0.856 and accuracy of 88.1%. In a head-to-head evaluation against three widely used general-purpose Indonesian sentiment models on the same test set, IndoBERT-Sentiment outperforms the best baseline by 35.6 F1 points. We show that context-conditioning, previously demonstrated for relevancy classification, transfers effectively to sentiment analysis and enables the model to correctly classify texts that are systematically misclassified by context-free approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了IndoBERT-Sentiment，一种基于主题上下文的情感分析模型，通过同时考虑主题背景和文本内容，显著提升了印尼语情感分类的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有印尼语情感分析模型孤立地分类文本，忽略了决定语句情感极性的主题上下文。主题背景对于判断一个陈述是积极、消极还是中性至关重要。
AI.method: 基于IndoBERT Large（3.35亿参数）构建，采用上下文条件化的情感分类器，同时接收主题上下文和文本作为输入。在188个主题的31,360个上下文-文本对上进行了训练。
AI.result: 模型取得了0.856的宏观F1分数和88.1%的准确率。在与三种广泛使用的通用印尼语情感模型的对比评估中，IndoBERT-Sentiment比最佳基线模型高出35.6个F1点。
AI.conclusion: 上下文条件化方法（先前已在相关性分类中证明有效）可以成功迁移到情感分析任务中，使模型能够正确分类那些被无上下文方法系统性地错误分类的文本。

title: PhyEdit: Towards Real-World Object Manipulation via Physically-Grounded Image Editing
