summary: Achieving physically accurate object manipulation in image editing is essential for its potential applications in interactive world models. However, existing visual generative models often fail at precise spatial manipulation, resulting in incorrect scaling and positioning of objects. This limitation primarily stems from the lack of explicit mechanisms to incorporate 3D geometry and perspective projection. To achieve accurate manipulation, we develop PhyEdit, an image editing framework that leverages explicit geometric simulation as contextual 3D-aware visual guidance. By combining this plug-and-play 3D prior with joint 2D--3D supervision, our method effectively improves physical accuracy and manipulation consistency. To support this method and evaluate performance, we present a real-world dataset, RealManip-10K, for 3D-aware object manipulation featuring paired images and depth annotations. We also propose ManipEval, a benchmark with multi-dimensional metrics to evaluate 3D spatial control and geometric consistency. Extensive experiments show that our approach outperforms existing methods, including strong closed-source models, in both 3D geometric accuracy and manipulation consistency.

AI.tldr: PhyEdit是一个图像编辑框架，通过显式几何模拟作为3D感知视觉引导，结合2D-3D联合监督，提升物体操作的物理准确性和一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉生成模型在精确空间操作方面存在不足，经常出现物体缩放和定位错误，主要原因是缺乏显式机制来融入3D几何和透视投影。
AI.method: 开发PhyEdit框架，利用显式几何模拟作为可插拔的3D先验，结合2D-3D联合监督；创建RealManip-10K真实世界数据集和ManipEval评估基准。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在3D几何准确性和操作一致性方面优于现有方法，包括强大的闭源模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式几何模拟和3D感知引导，PhyEdit能够实现物理准确的物体操作，为交互式世界模型应用提供了有效解决方案。

title: SemEval-2026 Task 3: Dimensional Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis (DimABSA)
summary: We present the SemEval-2026 shared task on Dimensional Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis (DimABSA), which improves traditional ABSA by modeling sentiment along valence-arousal (VA) dimensions rather than using categorical polarity labels. To extend ABSA beyond consumer reviews to public-issue discourse (e.g., political, energy, and climate issues), we introduce an additional task, Dimensional Stance Analysis (DimStance), which treats stance targets as aspects and reformulates stance detection as regression in the VA space. The task consists of two tracks: Track A (DimABSA) and Track B (DimStance). Track A includes three subtasks: (1) dimensional aspect sentiment regression, (2) dimensional aspect sentiment triplet extraction, and (3) dimensional aspect sentiment quadruplet extraction, while Track B includes only the regression subtask for stance targets. We also introduce a continuous F1 (cF1) metric to jointly evaluate structured extraction and VA regression. The task attracted more than 400 participants, resulting in 112 final submissions and 42 system description papers. We report baseline results, discuss top-performing systems, and analyze key design choices to provide insights into dimensional sentiment analysis at the aspect and stance-target levels. All resources are available on our GitHub repository.

AI.tldr: SemEval-2026共享任务提出维度方面情感分析(DimABSA)和维度立场分析(DimStance)，用效价-唤醒度维度替代传统分类标签，将ABSA扩展到公共议题领域，吸引了400多名参与者。
AI.motivation: 传统方面情感分析(ABSA)使用分类极性标签存在局限性，需要更细粒度的情感建模。同时，ABSA主要应用于消费者评论，需要扩展到公共议题领域如政治、能源、气候等。维度情感分析能提供更丰富的情感信息，而将立场检测重新定义为VA空间的回归问题可以统一分析框架。
AI.method: 任务分为两个轨道：Track A (DimABSA)包含三个子任务：(1)维度方面情感回归，(2)维度方面情感三元组提取，(3)维度方面情感四元组提取；Track B (DimStance)仅包含立场目标的回归子任务。引入连续F1(cF1)指标联合评估结构化提取和VA回归。提供基线系统，收集参与者提交的系统进行对比分析。
AI.result: 任务吸引了超过400名参与者，收到112份最终提交和42篇系统描述论文。报告了基线结果，分析了表现最佳的系统，讨论了关键设计选择，为方面和立场目标层面的维度情感分析提供了见解。所有资源已在GitHub仓库公开。
AI.conclusion: 维度方面情感分析和维度立场分析为情感分析提供了更细粒度的建模框架，成功将ABSA扩展到公共议题领域。连续F1指标有效评估了结构化提取和回归任务。该任务为维度情感分析在方面和立场层面的研究提供了有价值的基准和资源。

title: Is Cross-Lingual Transfer in Bilingual Models Human-Like? A Study with Overlapping Word Forms in Dutch and English
summary: Bilingual speakers show cross-lingual activation during reading, especially for words with shared surface form. Cognates (friends) typically lead to facilitation, whereas interlingual homographs (false friends) cause interference or no effect. We examine whether cross-lingual activation in bilingual language models mirrors these patterns. We train Dutch-English causal Transformers under four vocabulary-sharing conditions that manipulate whether (false) friends receive shared or language-specific embeddings. Using psycholinguistic stimuli from bilingual reading studies, we evaluate the models through surprisal and embedding similarity analyses. The models largely maintain language separation, and cross-lingual effects arise primarily when embeddings are shared. In these cases, both friends and false friends show facilitation relative to controls. Regression analyses reveal that these effects are mainly driven by frequency rather than consistency in form-meaning mapping. Only when just friends share embeddings are the qualitative patterns of bilinguals reproduced. Overall, bilingual language models capture some cross-linguistic activation effects. However, their alignment with human processing seems to critically depend on how lexical overlap is encoded, possibly limiting their explanatory adequacy as models of bilingual reading.

AI.tldr: 双语语言模型在词汇共享条件下能捕捉跨语言激活效应，但与人类阅读处理的匹配程度取决于词汇重叠的编码方式
AI.motivation: 研究双语者在阅读时会出现跨语言激活现象，特别是对于具有相同表面形式的词汇。同源词（朋友）通常产生促进效应，而跨语言同形异义词（假朋友）则引起干扰或无效应。本研究旨在探究双语语言模型中的跨语言激活是否反映这些人类处理模式。
AI.method: 训练荷兰语-英语因果Transformer模型，设置四种词汇共享条件，操纵（假）朋友是否获得共享或语言特定的嵌入表示。使用双语阅读研究的心理语言学刺激材料，通过惊奇度和嵌入相似性分析评估模型表现。
AI.result: 模型在很大程度上保持语言分离，跨语言效应主要在嵌入共享时出现。在这种情况下，朋友和假朋友相对于控制条件都显示促进效应。回归分析显示这些效应主要由频率驱动，而非形式-意义映射的一致性。只有当朋友共享嵌入时，才能重现双语者的定性模式。
AI.conclusion: 双语语言模型能捕捉一些跨语言激活效应，但它们与人类处理的对齐程度关键取决于词汇重叠的编码方式，这可能限制了它们作为双语阅读模型的解释充分性。

title: Non-identifiability of Explanations from Model Behavior in Deep Networks of Image Authenticity Judgments
summary: Deep neural networks can predict human judgments, but this does not imply that they rely on human-like information or reveal the cues underlying those judgments. Prior work has addressed this issue using attribution heatmaps, but their explanatory value in itself depends on robustness. Here we tested the robustness of such explanations by evaluating whether models that predict human authenticity ratings also produce consistent explanations within and across architectures. We fit lightweight regression heads to multiple frozen pretrained vision models and generated attribution maps using Grad-CAM, LIME, and multiscale pixel masking. Several architectures predicted ratings well, reaching about 80% of the noise ceiling. VGG models achieved this by tracking image quality rather than authenticity-specific variance, limiting the relevance of their attributions. Among the remaining models, attribution maps were generally stable across random seeds within an architecture, especially for EfficientNetB3 and Barlow Twins, and consistency was higher for images judged as more authentic. Crucially, agreement in attribution across architectures was weak even when predictive performance was similar. To address this, we combined models in ensembles, which improved prediction of human authenticity judgments and enabled image-level attribution via pixel masking. We conclude that while deep networks can predict human authenticity judgments well, they do not produce identifiable explanations for those judgments. More broadly, our findings suggest that post hoc explanations from successful models of behavior should be treated as weak evidence for cognitive mechanism.

AI.tldr: 深度神经网络能预测人类真实性判断，但解释不一致，跨架构一致性弱，后验解释不能作为认知机制的证据
AI.motivation: 研究深度神经网络预测人类真实性判断时，其解释是否稳健可靠，能否揭示人类判断的认知机制
AI.method: 使用多个预训练视觉模型，通过Grad-CAM、LIME和多尺度像素掩码生成归因图，比较不同架构和随机种子下的解释一致性
AI.result: 模型预测性能良好（达噪声上限80%），但VGG模型依赖图像质量而非真实性特征；架构内解释相对稳定，但跨架构一致性弱；集成模型能改善预测和归因
AI.conclusion: 深度网络能预测人类真实性判断，但无法提供可识别的解释；成功的行为模型的后验解释应被视为认知机制的弱证据

title: STRIDE-ED: A Strategy-Grounded Stepwise Reasoning Framework for Empathetic Dialogue Systems
summary: Empathetic dialogue requires not only recognizing a user's emotional state but also making strategy-aware, context-sensitive decisions throughout response generation. However, the lack of a comprehensive empathy strategy framework, explicit task-aligned multi-stage reasoning, and high-quality strategy-aware data fundamentally limits existing approaches, preventing them from effectively modeling empathetic dialogue as a complex, multi-stage cognitive and decision-making process. To address these challenges, we propose STRIDE-ED, a STRategy-grounded, Interpretable, and DEep reasoning framework that models Empathetic Dialogue through structured, strategy-conditioned reasoning. To support effective learning, we develop a strategy-aware data refinement pipeline integrating LLM-based annotation, multi-model consistency-weighted evaluation, and dynamic sampling to construct high-quality training data aligned with empathetic strategies. Furthermore, we adopt a two-stage training paradigm that combines supervised fine-tuning with multi-objective reinforcement learning to better align model behaviors with target emotions, empathetic strategies, and response formats. Extensive experiments demonstrate that STRIDE-ED generalizes across diverse open-source LLMs and consistently outperforms existing methods on both automatic metrics and human evaluations.

AI.tldr: STRIDE-ED是一个基于策略的、可解释的深度推理框架，通过结构化、策略条件化的推理来建模共情对话，显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有共情对话方法缺乏全面的共情策略框架、明确的任务对齐多阶段推理以及高质量的策略感知数据，无法有效建模共情对话作为复杂的多阶段认知和决策过程。
AI.method: 提出STRIDE-ED框架，采用策略感知数据精炼流程（LLM标注、多模型一致性加权评估、动态采样），以及两阶段训练范式（监督微调+多目标强化学习）。
AI.result: STRIDE-ED在不同开源LLM上均表现出良好的泛化能力，在自动指标和人工评估中一致优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: STRIDE-ED通过结构化策略条件化推理有效解决了共情对话建模的关键挑战，为复杂多阶段认知决策过程提供了有效框架。

title: Multilingual Embedding Probes Fail to Generalize Across Learner Corpora
summary: Do multilingual embedding models encode a language-general representation of proficiency? We investigate this by training linear and non-linear probes on hidden-state activations from Qwen3-Embedding (0.6B, 4B, 8B) to predict CEFR proficiency levels from learner texts across nine corpora and seven languages. We compare five probing architectures against a baseline trained on surface-level text features. Under in-distribution evaluation, probes achieve strong performance ($QWK\approx0.7$), substantially outperforming the surface baseline, with middle layers consistently yielding the best predictions. However, in cross-corpus evaluation performance collapses across all probe types and model sizes. Residual analysis reveals that out-of-distribution probes converge towards predicting uniformly distributed labels, indicating that the learned mappings capture corpus-specific distributional properties (topic, language, task type, rating methodology) rather than an abstract, transferable proficiency dimension. These results suggest that current multilingual embeddings do not straightforwardly encode language-general proficiency, with implications for representation-based approaches to proficiency-adaptive language technology.

AI.tldr: 研究探讨多语言嵌入模型是否编码了语言通用的熟练度表示，通过在不同模型层上训练探针预测CEFR水平，发现模型在分布内表现良好但跨语料库泛化失败，表明当前嵌入模型并未编码抽象可迁移的熟练度维度。
AI.motivation: 探究多语言嵌入模型是否能够编码语言通用的熟练度表示，这对于基于表示的方法在熟练度自适应语言技术中的应用具有重要意义。
AI.method: 在Qwen3-Embedding模型（0.6B、4B、8B）的隐藏状态激活上训练线性和非线性探针，预测来自9个语料库、7种语言的学习者文本的CEFR熟练度水平，并与基于表层文本特征的基线进行比较。
AI.result: 在分布内评估中，探针表现良好（QWK≈0.7），显著优于表层基线，中间层预测效果最佳；但在跨语料库评估中，所有探针类型和模型大小的性能都崩溃，残差分析显示探针学习到的是语料库特定的分布特性而非抽象可迁移的熟练度维度。
AI.conclusion: 当前多语言嵌入模型并未直接编码语言通用的熟练度表示，这对基于表示的方法在熟练度自适应语言技术中的应用提出了挑战。

title: GenLCA: 3D Diffusion for Full-Body Avatars from In-the-Wild Videos
summary: We present GenLCA, a diffusion-based generative model for generating and editing photorealistic full-body avatars from text and image inputs. The generated avatars are faithful to the inputs, while supporting high-fidelity facial and full-body animations. The core idea is a novel paradigm that enables training a full-body 3D diffusion model from partially observable 2D data, allowing the training dataset to scale to millions of real-world videos. This scalability contributes to the superior photorealism and generalizability of GenLCA. Specifically, we scale up the dataset by repurposing a pretrained feed-forward avatar reconstruction model as an animatable 3D tokenizer, which encodes unstructured video frames into structured 3D tokens. However, most real-world videos only provide partial observations of body parts, resulting in excessive blurring or transparency artifacts in the 3D tokens. To address this, we propose a novel visibility-aware diffusion training strategy that replaces invalid regions with learnable tokens and computes losses only over valid regions. We then train a flow-based diffusion model on the token dataset, inherently maintaining the photorealism and animatability provided by the pretrained avatar reconstruction model. Our approach effectively enables the use of large-scale real-world video data to train a diffusion model natively in 3D. We demonstrate the efficacy of our method through diverse and high-fidelity generation and editing results, outperforming existing solutions by a large margin. The project page is available at https://onethousandwu.com/GenLCA-Page.

AI.tldr: GenLCA是一个基于扩散模型的生成模型，能够从文本和图像输入生成和编辑逼真的全身虚拟化身，支持高保真面部和全身动画。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在生成逼真全身虚拟化身方面存在局限性，难以利用大规模真实世界视频数据进行训练，导致生成效果不够真实和泛化能力有限。
AI.method: 1) 使用预训练的前馈虚拟化身重建模型作为可动画化的3D标记器，将非结构化视频帧编码为结构化3D标记；2) 提出可见性感知扩散训练策略，用可学习标记替换无效区域，仅在有效区域计算损失；3) 在标记数据集上训练基于流的扩散模型，保持预训练模型的真实感和可动画性。
AI.result: GenLCA能够生成多样化和高保真的虚拟化身，支持生成和编辑功能，在真实感和动画质量方面大幅超越现有解决方案。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效利用大规模真实世界视频数据训练3D扩散模型，实现了逼真全身虚拟化身的生成和编辑，为3D内容创作提供了新的可能性。

title: Mem3R: Streaming 3D Reconstruction with Hybrid Memory via Test-Time Training
summary: Streaming 3D perception is well suited to robotics and augmented reality, where long visual streams must be processed efficiently and consistently. Recent recurrent models offer a promising solution by maintaining fixed-size states and enabling linear-time inference, but they often suffer from drift accumulation and temporal forgetting over long sequences due to the limited capacity of compressed latent memories. We propose Mem3R, a streaming 3D reconstruction model with a hybrid memory design that decouples camera tracking from geometric mapping to improve temporal consistency over long sequences. For camera tracking, Mem3R employs an implicit fast-weight memory implemented as a lightweight Multi-Layer Perceptron updated via Test-Time Training. For geometric mapping, Mem3R maintains an explicit token-based fixed-size state. Compared with CUT3R, this design not only significantly improves long-sequence performance but also reduces the model size from 793M to 644M parameters. Mem3R supports existing improved plug-and-play state update strategies developed for CUT3R. Specifically, integrating it with TTT3R decreases Absolute Trajectory Error by up to 39% over the base implementation on 500 to 1000 frame sequences. The resulting improvements also extend to other downstream tasks, including video depth estimation and 3D reconstruction, while preserving constant GPU memory usage and comparable inference throughput. Project page: https://lck666666.github.io/Mem3R/

AI.tldr: Mem3R是一个流式3D感知模型，采用混合内存设计分离相机跟踪和几何映射，通过隐式快速权重内存和显式令牌状态提升长序列性能，参数量从793M减少到644M，轨迹误差降低39%。
AI.motivation: 当前流式3D感知中的循环模型虽然能实现线性时间推理，但由于压缩潜在记忆容量有限，容易在长序列中出现漂移累积和时间遗忘问题，需要改进长期一致性。
AI.method: 提出混合内存设计：1）相机跟踪使用轻量级多层感知器实现的隐式快速权重内存，通过测试时训练更新；2）几何映射使用显式令牌固定大小状态。支持CUT3R的即插即用状态更新策略。
AI.result: 相比CUT3R，模型参数量从793M减少到644M，在500-1000帧序列上绝对轨迹误差降低达39%，同时保持恒定GPU内存使用和可比推理吞吐量，在视频深度估计和3D重建等下游任务也有改进。
AI.conclusion: Mem3R通过解耦相机跟踪和几何映射的混合内存设计，有效解决了流式3D感知中的长期一致性问题，在减少模型规模的同时显著提升了长序列性能，为机器人和增强现实应用提供了高效解决方案。

title: Yale-DM-Lab at ArchEHR-QA 2026: Deterministic Grounding and Multi-Pass Evidence Alignment for EHR Question Answering
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures. System description for ArchEHR-QA 2026 shared task
summary: We describe the Yale-DM-Lab system for the ArchEHR-QA 2026 shared task. The task studies patient-authored questions about hospitalization records and contains four subtasks (ST): clinician-interpreted question reformulation, evidence sentence identification, answer generation, and evidence-answer alignment. ST1 uses a dual-model pipeline with Claude Sonnet 4 and GPT-4o to reformulate patient questions into clinician-interpreted questions. ST2-ST4 rely on Azure-hosted model ensembles (o3, GPT-5.2, GPT-5.1, and DeepSeek-R1) combined with few-shot prompting and voting strategies. Our experiments show three main findings. First, model diversity and ensemble voting consistently improve performance compared to single-model baselines. Second, the full clinician answer paragraph is provided as additional prompt context for evidence alignment. Third, results on the development set show that alignment accuracy is mainly limited by reasoning. The best scores on the development set reach 88.81 micro F1 on ST4, 65.72 macro F1 on ST2, 34.01 on ST3, and 33.05 on ST1.

AI.tldr: Yale-DM-Lab系统在ArchEHR-QA 2026共享任务中采用多模型集成方法处理患者对住院记录的提问，包含四个子任务：临床问题重构、证据句子识别、答案生成和证据-答案对齐。
AI.motivation: 研究如何有效处理患者对医疗记录的提问，通过将患者问题转化为临床可解释的形式，并准确识别相关证据、生成答案并进行对齐，提高医疗问答系统的实用性。
AI.method: ST1使用Claude Sonnet 4和GPT-4o的双模型管道进行问题重构；ST2-ST4采用Azure托管的模型集成（o3、GPT-5.2、GPT-5.1、DeepSeek-R1），结合少样本提示和投票策略；在证据对齐任务中提供完整的临床答案段落作为额外上下文。
AI.result: 模型多样性和集成投票相比单模型基线持续提升性能；开发集上最佳得分：ST4达到88.81微F1，ST2达到65.72宏F1，ST3达到34.01，ST1达到33.05；证据对齐的准确性主要受推理能力限制。
AI.conclusion: 多模型集成方法在医疗问答任务中表现有效，模型多样性是关键因素；证据对齐任务需要更强的推理能力；系统在开发集上取得了有竞争力的结果，为医疗记录问答提供了实用解决方案。

title: Region-Graph Optimal Transport Routing for Mixture-of-Experts Whole-Slide Image Classification
summary: Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) is the dominant framework for gigapixel whole-slide image (WSI) classification in computational pathology. However, current MIL aggregators route all instances through a shared pathway, constraining their capacity to specialise across the pathological heterogeneity inherent in each slide. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) methods offer a natural remedy by partitioning instances across specialised expert subnetworks; yet unconstrained softmax routing may yield highly imbalanced utilisation, where one or a few experts absorb most routing mass, collapsing the mixture back to a near-single-pathway solution. To address these limitations, we propose ROAM (Region-graph OptimAl-transport Mixture-of-experts), a spatially aware MoE-MIL aggregator that routes region tokens to expert poolers via capacity-constrained entropic optimal transport, promoting balanced expert utilisation by construction. ROAM operates on spatial region tokens, obtained by compressing dense patch bags into spatially binned units that align routing with local tissue neighbourhoods and introduces two key mechanisms: (i) region-to-expert assignment formulated as entropic optimal transport (Sinkhorn) with explicit per slide capacity marginals, enforcing balanced expert utilisation without auxiliary load-balancing losses; and (ii) graph-regularised Sinkhorn iterations that diffuse routing assignments over the spatial region graph, encouraging neighbouring regions to coherently route to the same experts. Evaluated on four WSI benchmarks with frozen foundation-model patch embeddings, ROAM achieves performance competitive against strong MIL and MoE baselines, and on NSCLC generalisation (TCGA-CPTAC) reaches external AUC 0.845 +- 0.019.

AI.tldr: ROAM是一种用于计算病理学中全切片图像分类的空间感知混合专家MIL聚合器，通过容量约束的熵最优传输实现区域到专家的平衡分配，并引入图正则化确保空间邻域一致性。
AI.motivation: 当前MIL聚合器将所有实例通过共享路径路由，限制了在病理异质性中专业化的能力。混合专家方法虽然提供了专业化解决方案，但无约束的softmax路由可能导致专家利用高度不平衡，使混合方法退化为近似单路径解决方案。
AI.method: ROAM将密集补丁袋压缩为空间分箱的区域标记，通过容量约束的熵最优传输（Sinkhorn）将区域分配到专家池，并引入图正则化的Sinkhorn迭代，在空间区域图上扩散路由分配，鼓励相邻区域一致地路由到相同专家。
AI.result: 在四个WSI基准测试中使用冻结基础模型补丁嵌入进行评估，ROAM性能与强MIL和MoE基线竞争，在NSCLC泛化（TCGA-CPTAC）上达到外部AUC 0.845 ± 0.019。
AI.conclusion: ROAM通过容量约束的熵最优传输和图正则化，实现了平衡的专家利用和空间一致的路由，为计算病理学中的全切片图像分类提供了一种有效的混合专家MIL聚合器。

title: Are Non-English Papers Reviewed Fairly? Language-of-Study Bias in NLP Peer Reviews
summary: Peer review plays a central role in the NLP publication process, but is susceptible to various biases. Here, we study language-of-study (LoS) bias: the tendency for reviewers to evaluate a paper differently based on the language(s) it studies, rather than its scientific merit. Despite being explicitly flagged in reviewing guidelines, such biases are poorly understood. Prior work treats such comments as part of broader categories of weak or unconstructive reviews without defining them as a distinct form of bias. We present the first systematic characterization of LoS bias, distinguishing negative and positive forms, and introduce the human-annotated dataset LOBSTER (Language-Of-study Bias in ScienTific pEer Review) and a method achieving 87.37 macro F1 for detection. We analyze 15,645 reviews to estimate how negative and positive biases differ with respect to the LoS, and find that non-English papers face substantially higher bias rates than English-only ones, with negative bias consistently outweighing positive bias. Finally, we identify four subcategories of negative bias, and find that demanding unjustified cross-lingual generalization is the most dominant form. We publicly release all resources to support work on fairer reviewing practices in NLP and beyond.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次系统性地定义了语言研究偏见（LoS bias），即审稿人基于论文研究的语言而非科学价值进行评价的倾向，并创建了LOBSTER数据集和检测方法，发现非英语论文面临更高的偏见率。
AI.motivation: 尽管NLP评审指南明确指出了语言研究偏见，但这种现象缺乏系统研究。先前工作将相关评论归为弱评审或非建设性评审的宽泛类别，而没有将其定义为一种独特的偏见形式。本研究旨在填补这一空白，系统性地识别和量化语言研究偏见。
AI.method: 研究提出了语言研究偏见的系统性特征描述，区分了负面和正面偏见形式。创建了人工标注的数据集LOBSTER（Language-Of-study Bias in ScienTific pEer Review），并开发了检测方法，在15,645篇评审中实现了87.37的宏观F1分数。识别了负面偏见的四个子类别。
AI.result: 分析发现非英语论文面临的偏见率显著高于纯英语论文，且负面偏见始终超过正面偏见。在负面偏见的四个子类别中，要求不合理跨语言泛化是最主要的形式。检测方法达到了87.37的宏观F1分数。
AI.conclusion: 该研究首次系统性地定义了语言研究偏见，提供了检测方法和数据集，揭示了非英语论文在同行评审中面临的不公平待遇。所有资源已公开，以支持NLP及其他领域更公平的评审实践。

title: Beyond Loss Values: Robust Dynamic Pruning via Loss Trajectory Alignment
summary: Existing dynamic data pruning methods often fail under noisy-label settings, as they typically rely on per-sample loss as the ranking criterion. This could mistakenly lead to preserving noisy samples due to their high loss values, resulting in significant performance drop. To address this, we propose AlignPrune, a noise-robust module designed to enhance the reliability of dynamic pruning under label noise. Specifically, AlignPrune introduces the Dynamic Alignment Score (DAS), which is a loss-trajectory-based criterion that enables more accurate identification of noisy samples, thereby improving pruning effectiveness. As a simple yet effective plug-and-play module, AlignPrune can be seamlessly integrated into state-of-the-art dynamic pruning frameworks, consistently outperforming them without modifying either the model architecture or the training pipeline. Extensive experiments on five widely-used benchmarks across various noise types and pruning ratios demonstrate the effectiveness of AlignPrune, boosting accuracy by up to 6.3\% over state-of-the-art baselines. Our results offer a generalizable solution for pruning under noisy data, encouraging further exploration of learning in real-world scenarios. Code is available at: https://github.com/leonqin430/AlignPrune.

AI.tldr: AlignPrune是一个噪声鲁棒的动态数据剪枝模块，通过基于损失轨迹的动态对齐评分来更准确识别噪声样本，提升在噪声标签设置下的剪枝效果。
AI.motivation: 现有的动态数据剪枝方法在噪声标签设置下效果不佳，因为它们通常依赖每个样本的损失作为排序标准。这可能导致错误地保留噪声样本（因为噪声样本通常有较高的损失值），从而导致显著的性能下降。
AI.method: 提出了AlignPrune模块，引入了动态对齐评分（DAS）——一种基于损失轨迹的准则，能够更准确地识别噪声样本。这是一个简单有效的即插即用模块，可以无缝集成到最先进的动态剪枝框架中，无需修改模型架构或训练流程。
AI.result: 在五种广泛使用的基准测试上，针对不同类型的噪声和剪枝比例进行了大量实验。AlignPrune始终优于现有基线方法，准确率提升最高达6.3%。
AI.conclusion: AlignPrune为噪声数据下的剪枝提供了一个可泛化的解决方案，鼓励在真实世界场景中进一步探索学习。代码已开源。

title: Language Bias under Conflicting Information in Multilingual LLMs
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been shown to contain biases in the process of integrating conflicting information when answering questions. Here we ask whether such biases also exist with respect to which language is used for each conflicting piece of information. To answer this question, we extend the conflicting needles in a haystack paradigm to a multilingual setting and perform a comprehensive set of evaluations with naturalistic news domain data in five different languages, for a range of multilingual LLMs of different sizes. We find that all LLMs tested, including GPT-5.2, ignore the conflict and confidently assert only one of the possible answers in the large majority of cases. Furthermore, there is a consistent bias across models in which languages are preferred, with a general bias against Russian and, for the longest context lengths, in favor of Chinese. Both of these patterns are consistent between models trained inside and outside of mainland China, though somewhat stronger in the former category.

AI.tldr: 研究发现多语言大语言模型在处理多语言冲突信息时存在语言偏见，倾向于忽略冲突并自信地只给出一种答案，且普遍对俄语有偏见，在长上下文场景下对中文有偏好。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是探究大语言模型在处理多语言冲突信息时是否存在语言偏见，特别是在不同语言信息相互矛盾的情况下，模型是否会对某些语言有系统性偏好。
AI.method: 将"干草堆中的冲突针"范式扩展到多语言环境，使用五种不同语言的新闻领域数据，对多种不同规模的多语言大语言模型进行全面评估，包括GPT-5.2等模型。
AI.result: 所有测试的LLM在大多数情况下都忽略冲突信息，自信地只给出一种可能的答案；存在一致的语言偏好模式：普遍对俄语有偏见，在最长上下文长度下对中文有偏好；这种模式在中国境内和境外训练的模型中都有体现，但在前者中更为明显。
AI.conclusion: 多语言大语言模型在处理多语言冲突信息时存在系统性语言偏见，这揭示了模型在跨语言信息整合中的局限性，对多语言AI系统的开发具有重要意义。

title: From Blobs to Spokes: High-Fidelity Surface Reconstruction via Oriented Gaussians
comment: Our project page is available in http://diego1401.github.io/BlobsToSpokesWebsite/index.html
summary:
3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has revolutionized fast novel view synthesis, yet its opacity-based formulation makes surface extraction fundamentally difficult. Unlike implicit methods built on Signed Distance Fields or occupancy, 3DGS lacks a global geometric field, forcing existing approaches to resort to heuristics such as TSDF fusion of blended depth maps.
  Inspired by the Objects as Volumes framework, we derive a principled occupancy field for Gaussian Splatting and show how it can be used to extract highly accurate watertight meshes of complex scenes. Our key contribution is to introduce a learnable oriented normal at each Gaussian element and to define an adapted attenuation formulation, which leads to closed-form expressions for both the normal and occupancy fields at arbitrary locations in space. We further introduce a novel consistency loss and a dedicated densification strategy to enforce Gaussians to wrap the entire surface by closing geometric holes, ensuring a complete shell of oriented primitives. We modify the differentiable rasterizer to output depth as an isosurface of our continuous model, and introduce Primal Adaptive Meshing for Region-of-Interest meshing at arbitrary resolution.
  We additionally expose fundamental biases in standard surface evaluation protocols and propose two more rigorous alternatives. Overall, our method Gaussian Wrapping sets a new state-of-the-art on DTU and Tanks and Temples, producing complete, watertight meshes at a fraction of the size of concurrent work-recovering thin structures such as the notoriously elusive bicycle spokes.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了Gaussian Wrapping方法，为3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）引入可学习的法向量和衰减公式，构建几何一致的占用场，实现高质量水密网格提取。
AI.motivation: 3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）虽然实现了快速新视角合成，但其基于不透明度的表示使得表面提取变得困难。与基于符号距离场或占用场的隐式方法不同，3DGS缺乏全局几何场，现有方法只能依赖启发式方法如TSDF融合。
AI.method: 1. 为每个高斯元素引入可学习的定向法向量；2. 定义适应的衰减公式，推导出空间任意位置的法向量场和占用场的闭式表达式；3. 引入一致性损失和专门的致密化策略，确保高斯元素包裹整个表面；4. 修改可微分光栅化器，输出连续模型的等值面深度；5. 提出Primal Adaptive Meshing进行感兴趣区域的多分辨率网格化。
AI.result: 在DTU和Tanks and Temples数据集上达到新的最先进水平，能够生成完整的水密网格，网格尺寸比同期工作小得多，能够恢复薄结构如自行车辐条等难以捕捉的细节。
AI.conclusion: Gaussian Wrapping方法为3D高斯泼溅提供了几何一致的占用场表示，解决了表面提取的根本难题，同时揭示了标准表面评估协议中的基本偏差，提出了更严格的替代方案。

title: Agent-Driven Corpus Linguistics: A Framework for Autonomous Linguistic Discovery
summary: Corpus linguistics has traditionally relied on human researchers to formulate hypotheses, construct queries, and interpret results - a process demanding specialized technical skills and considerable time. We propose Agent-Driven Corpus Linguistics, an approach in which a large language model (LLM), connected to a corpus query engine via a structured tool-use interface, takes over the investigative cycle: generating hypotheses, querying the corpus, interpreting results, and refining analysis across multiple rounds. The human researcher sets direction and evaluates final output. Unlike unconstrained LLM generation, every finding is anchored in verifiable corpus evidence. We treat this not as a replacement for the corpus-based/corpus-driven distinction but as a complementary dimension: it concerns who conducts the inquiry, not the epistemological relationship between theory and data. We demonstrate the framework by linking an LLM agent to a CQP-indexed Gutenberg corpus (5 million tokens) via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Given only "investigate English intensifiers," the agent identified a diachronic relay chain (so+ADJ > very > really), three pathways of semantic change (delexicalization, polarity fixation, metaphorical constraint), and register-sensitive distributions. A controlled baseline experiment shows that corpus grounding contributes quantification and falsifiability that the model cannot produce from training data alone. To test external validity, the agent replicated two published studies on the CLMET corpus (40 million tokens) - Claridge (2025) and De Smet (2013) - with close quantitative agreement. Agent-driven corpus research can thus produce empirically grounded findings at machine speed, lowering the technical barrier for a broader range of researchers.

AI.tldr: 提出Agent-Driven Corpus Linguistics框架，让LLM代理通过结构化工具接口连接语料库查询引擎，自动完成假设生成、查询、结果解释和迭代分析的研究循环，人类研究者只需设定方向和评估结果。
AI.motivation: 传统语料库语言学依赖研究人员手动完成假设制定、查询构建和结果解释，这需要专业技能和大量时间。本文旨在降低技术门槛，让更广泛的研究者能够进行语料库研究，同时保持实证基础。
AI.method: 通过Model Context Protocol（MCP）将LLM代理连接到CQP索引的Gutenberg语料库（500万词），构建结构化工具使用接口。代理在人类指导下自动执行研究循环：生成假设、查询语料库、解释结果、迭代分析。所有发现都基于可验证的语料库证据。
AI.result: 1）在"调查英语强化词"任务中，代理识别出历时接力链（so+ADJ > very > really）、三种语义变化路径（去词汇化、极性固定、隐喻约束）和语域敏感分布；2）对照实验显示语料库基础提供了模型无法从训练数据中产生的量化和可证伪性；3）在CLMET语料库（4000万词）上成功复现了两个已发表研究，获得接近的定量一致性。
AI.conclusion: Agent-Driven Corpus Linguistics能够以机器速度产生基于实证的研究发现，降低技术门槛，使更广泛的研究者能够进行语料库研究。这不是要取代语料库驱动/基于语料库的区分，而是作为补充维度，关注谁进行研究而非理论与数据之间的认识论关系。

title: Appear2Meaning: A Cross-Cultural Benchmark for Structured Cultural Metadata Inference from Images
summary: Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) have improved image captioning for cultural heritage. However, inferring structured cultural metadata (e.g., creator, origin, period) from visual input remains underexplored. We introduce a multi-category, cross-cultural benchmark for this task and evaluate VLMs using an LLM-as-Judge framework that measures semantic alignment with reference annotations. To assess cultural reasoning, we report exact-match, partial-match, and attribute-level accuracy across cultural regions. Results show that models capture fragmented signals and exhibit substantial performance variation across cultures and metadata types, leading to inconsistent and weakly grounded predictions. These findings highlight the limitations of current VLMs in structured cultural metadata inference beyond visual perception.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了视觉语言模型在文化遗产结构化元数据推断方面的能力，发现现有模型在不同文化和元数据类型上表现不一致，存在局限性。
AI.motivation: 尽管视觉语言模型在文化遗产图像描述方面有所进展，但从视觉输入推断结构化文化元数据（如创作者、起源、时期）仍未被充分探索，需要系统评估模型在这方面的能力。
AI.method: 引入了一个多类别、跨文化的基准测试，使用LLM-as-Judge框架评估视觉语言模型，通过语义对齐参考标注来衡量性能，并报告跨文化区域的精确匹配、部分匹配和属性级准确率。
AI.result: 结果显示模型仅能捕捉碎片化信号，在不同文化和元数据类型上表现出显著性能差异，导致预测不一致且缺乏充分依据，突显了当前模型在结构化文化元数据推断方面的局限性。
AI.conclusion: 当前视觉语言模型在超越视觉感知的结构化文化元数据推断方面存在明显局限，需要进一步改进以更好地理解和推断文化遗产的复杂文化属性。

title: LaScA: Language-Conditioned Scalable Modelling of Affective Dynamics
comment: This paper has been accepted at the CVPR 2026 Workshop on Affective Behavior Analysis in-the-wild (ABAW)
summary: Predicting affect in unconstrained environments remains a fundamental challenge in human-centered AI. While deep neural embeddings dominate contemporary approaches, they often lack interpretability and limit expert-driven refinement. We propose a novel framework that uses Language Models (LMs) as semantic context conditioners over handcrafted affect descriptors to model changes in Valence and Arousal. Our approach begins with interpretable facial geometry and acoustic features derived from structured domain knowledge. These features are transformed into symbolic natural-language descriptions encoding their affective implications. A pretrained LM processes these descriptions to generate semantic context embeddings that act as high-level priors over affective dynamics. Unlike end-to-end black-box pipelines, our framework preserves feature transparency while leveraging the contextual abstraction capabilities of LMs. We evaluate the proposed method on the Aff-Wild2 and SEWA datasets for affect change prediction. Experimental results show consistent improvements in accuracy for both Valence and Arousal compared to handcrafted-only and deep-embedding baselines. Our findings demonstrate that semantic conditioning enables interpretable affect modelling without sacrificing predictive performance, offering a transparent and computationally efficient alternative to fully end-to-end architectures

AI.tldr: 提出一种使用语言模型作为语义上下文条件器的新框架，通过手工制作的情感描述符来建模效价和唤醒度的变化，在保持可解释性的同时提升预测性能
AI.motivation: 当前在无约束环境中预测情感的主要挑战是深度神经嵌入方法缺乏可解释性，限制了专家驱动的改进。需要一种既能保持特征透明度又能利用语言模型上下文抽象能力的方法。
AI.method: 从结构化领域知识中提取可解释的面部几何和声学特征，将其转化为编码情感含义的符号化自然语言描述。使用预训练语言模型处理这些描述，生成作为情感动态高级先验的语义上下文嵌入。
AI.result: 在Aff-Wild2和SEWA数据集上进行情感变化预测实验，结果显示在效价和唤醒度预测准确性上均优于仅使用手工特征和深度嵌入基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 语义条件化方法能够在保持可解释性的同时不牺牲预测性能，为完全端到端架构提供了透明且计算高效的替代方案。

title: TC-AE: Unlocking Token Capacity for Deep Compression Autoencoders
summary: We propose TC-AE, a ViT-based architecture for deep compression autoencoders. Existing methods commonly increase the channel number of latent representations to maintain reconstruction quality under high compression ratios. However, this strategy often leads to latent representation collapse, which degrades generative performance. Instead of relying on increasingly complex architectures or multi-stage training schemes, TC-AE addresses this challenge from the perspective of the token space, the key bridge between pixels and image latents, through two complementary innovations: Firstly, we study token number scaling by adjusting the patch size in ViT under a fixed latent budget, and identify aggressive token-to-latent compression as the key factor that limits effective scaling. To address this issue, we decompose token-to-latent compression into two stages, reducing structural information loss and enabling effective token number scaling for generation. Secondly, to further mitigate latent representation collapse, we enhance the semantic structure of image tokens via joint self-supervised training, leading to more generative-friendly latents. With these designs, TC-AE achieves substantially improved reconstruction and generative performance under deep compression. We hope our research will advance ViT-based tokenizer for visual generation.

AI.tldr: TC-AE是一种基于ViT的深度压缩自编码器架构，通过调整token空间而非增加通道数来改善高压缩比下的重建和生成性能，解决了潜在表示崩溃问题。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常通过增加潜在表示的通道数来维持高压缩比下的重建质量，但这往往导致潜在表示崩溃，从而降低生成性能。需要一种新方法来避免这种问题。
AI.method: TC-AE从token空间角度提出两个创新：1) 在固定潜在预算下通过调整patch大小研究token数量缩放，将token到潜在压缩分解为两个阶段以减少结构信息损失；2) 通过联合自监督训练增强图像token的语义结构，获得更适合生成的潜在表示。
AI.result: TC-AE在深度压缩下实现了显著改进的重建和生成性能，为基于ViT的视觉生成tokenizer提供了新思路。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过从token空间角度解决潜在表示崩溃问题，为基于ViT的视觉生成tokenizer提供了有效方法，有望推动该领域的发展。

title: Efficient Learned Data Compression via Dual-Stream Feature Decoupling
summary: While Learned Data Compression (LDC) has achieved superior compression ratios, balancing precise probability modeling with system efficiency remains challenging. Crucially, uniform single-stream architectures struggle to simultaneously capture micro-syntactic and macro-semantic features, necessitating deep serial stacking that exacerbates latency. Compounding this, heterogeneous systems are constrained by device speed mismatches, where throughput is capped by Amdahl's Law due to serial processing. To this end, we propose a Dual-Stream Multi-Scale Decoupler that disentangles local and global contexts to replace deep serial processing with shallow parallel streams, and incorporate a Hierarchical Gated Refiner for adaptive feature refinement and precise probability modeling. Furthermore, we design a Concurrent Stream-Parallel Pipeline, which overcomes systemic bottlenecks to achieve full-pipeline parallelism. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in both compression ratio and throughput, while maintaining the lowest latency and memory usage. The code is available at https://github.com/huidong-ma/FADE.

AI.tldr: 提出双流多尺度解耦器，通过并行处理局部和全局上下文来替代深度串行堆叠，结合分层门控细化器和并发流并行流水线，在保持高压缩率的同时显著提升吞吐量和降低延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有学习型数据压缩方法在精确概率建模与系统效率之间难以平衡。单一流架构无法同时捕获微观语法和宏观语义特征，需要深度串行堆叠导致延迟增加。此外，异构系统受限于设备速度不匹配，串行处理导致吞吐量受阿姆达尔定律限制。
AI.method: 1. 双流多尺度解耦器：解耦局部和全局上下文，用浅层并行流替代深度串行处理；2. 分层门控细化器：用于自适应特征细化和精确概率建模；3. 并发流并行流水线：克服系统瓶颈，实现全流水线并行。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法在压缩率和吞吐量方面均达到最先进性能，同时保持最低延迟和内存使用。
AI.conclusion: 提出的双流多尺度解耦架构通过并行化处理有效解决了学习型数据压缩中的效率瓶颈问题，在保持高压缩性能的同时显著提升了系统效率。

title: MoRight: Motion Control Done Right
summary: Generating motion-controlled videos--where user-specified actions drive physically plausible scene dynamics under freely chosen viewpoints--demands two capabilities: (1) disentangled motion control, allowing users to separately control the object motion and adjust camera viewpoint; and (2) motion causality, ensuring that user-driven actions trigger coherent reactions from other objects rather than merely displacing pixels. Existing methods fall short on both fronts: they entangle camera and object motion into a single tracking signal and treat motion as kinematic displacement without modeling causal relationships between object motion. We introduce MoRight, a unified framework that addresses both limitations through disentangled motion modeling. Object motion is specified in a canonical static-view and transferred to an arbitrary target camera viewpoint via temporal cross-view attention, enabling disentangled camera and object control. We further decompose motion into active (user-driven) and passive (consequence) components, training the model to learn motion causality from data. At inference, users can either supply active motion and MoRight predicts consequences (forward reasoning), or specify desired passive outcomes and MoRight recovers plausible driving actions (inverse reasoning), all while freely adjusting the camera viewpoint. Experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in generation quality, motion controllability, and interaction awareness.

AI.tldr: MoRight是一个统一的视频生成框架，通过解耦运动建模实现用户指定的动作控制和自由视角调整，同时学习运动因果关系，支持前向推理和逆向推理。
AI.motivation: 现有方法存在两个主要问题：1) 将相机运动和物体运动纠缠在单一跟踪信号中；2) 将运动视为运动学位移，没有建模物体运动之间的因果关系。这限制了用户对运动和视角的独立控制能力，以及生成物理合理场景动态的能力。
AI.method: 提出MoRight框架，通过解耦运动建模解决上述问题：1) 在静态规范视图中指定物体运动，通过时间跨视图注意力将运动转移到任意目标相机视角，实现相机和物体控制的解耦；2) 将运动分解为主动（用户驱动）和被动（后果）组件，从数据中学习运动因果关系。
AI.result: 在三个基准测试上展示了最先进的性能，包括生成质量、运动可控性和交互感知能力。用户可以通过前向推理（提供主动运动预测后果）或逆向推理（指定被动结果恢复驱动动作）来控制生成，同时自由调整相机视角。
AI.conclusion: MoRight通过解耦运动建模和因果关系学习，实现了对运动控制视频生成的改进，允许用户独立控制物体运动和相机视角，同时生成物理合理的场景动态，为交互式视频生成提供了新的可能性。

title: Fast Spatial Memory with Elastic Test-Time Training
summary: Large Chunk Test-Time Training (LaCT) has shown strong performance on long-context 3D reconstruction, but its fully plastic inference-time updates remain vulnerable to catastrophic forgetting and overfitting. As a result, LaCT is typically instantiated with a single large chunk spanning the full input sequence, falling short of the broader goal of handling arbitrarily long sequences in a single pass. We propose Elastic Test-Time Training inspired by elastic weight consolidation, that stabilizes LaCT fast-weight updates with a Fisher-weighted elastic prior around a maintained anchor state. The anchor evolves as an exponential moving average of past fast weights to balance stability and plasticity. Based on this updated architecture, we introduce Fast Spatial Memory (FSM), an efficient and scalable model for 4D reconstruction that learns spatiotemporal representations from long observation sequences and renders novel view-time combinations. We pre-trained FSM on large-scale curated 3D/4D data to capture the dynamics and semantics of complex spatial environments. Extensive experiments show that FSM supports fast adaptation over long sequences and delivers high-quality 3D/4D reconstruction with smaller chunks and mitigating the camera-interpolation shortcut. Overall, we hope to advance LaCT beyond the bounded single-chunk setting toward robust multi-chunk adaptation, a necessary step for generalization to genuinely longer sequences, while substantially alleviating the activation-memory bottleneck.

AI.tldr: 提出Elastic Test-Time Training方法，结合弹性权重巩固来稳定LaCT的快速权重更新，并引入Fast Spatial Memory模型用于高效可扩展的4D重建。
AI.motivation: 现有Large Chunk Test-Time Training (LaCT)方法在长上下文3D重建中表现良好，但完全可塑的推理时更新容易遭受灾难性遗忘和过拟合，通常只能使用单个大块处理完整输入序列，无法实现真正处理任意长序列的目标。
AI.method: 提出Elastic Test-Time Training，受弹性权重巩固启发，使用Fisher加权的弹性先验来稳定LaCT的快速权重更新，锚点状态通过过去快速权重的指数移动平均演化以平衡稳定性和可塑性。基于此架构引入Fast Spatial Memory (FSM)，一个高效可扩展的4D重建模型，从长观测序列学习时空表示并渲染新视角-时间组合。
AI.result: FSM在大规模精选3D/4D数据上预训练，捕捉复杂空间环境的动态和语义。实验表明FSM支持长序列上的快速适应，使用更小的块实现高质量3D/4D重建，并减轻相机插值捷径问题。
AI.conclusion: 该方法将LaCT从有界单块设置推进到鲁棒的多块适应，这是泛化到真正更长序列的必要步骤，同时显著缓解激活内存瓶颈问题。

title: Evaluating In-Context Translation with Synchronous Context-Free Grammar Transduction
summary: Low-resource languages pose a challenge for machine translation with large language models (LLMs), which require large amounts of training data. One potential way to circumvent this data dependence is to rely on LLMs' ability to use in-context descriptions of languages, like textbooks and dictionaries. To do so, LLMs must be able to infer the link between the languages' grammatical descriptions and the sentences in question. Here we isolate this skill using a formal analogue of the task: string transduction based on a formal grammar provided in-context. We construct synchronous context-free grammars which define pairs of formal languages designed to model particular aspects of natural language grammar, morphology, and written representation. Using these grammars, we measure how well LLMs can translate sentences from one formal language into another when given both the grammar and the source-language sentence. We vary the size of the grammar, the lengths of the sentences, the syntactic and morphological properties of the languages, and their written script. We note three key findings. First, LLMs' translation accuracy decreases markedly as a function of grammar size and sentence length. Second, differences in morphology and written representation between the source and target languages can strongly diminish model performance. Third, we examine the types of errors committed by models and find they are most prone to recall the wrong words from the target language vocabulary, hallucinate new words, or leave source-language words untranslated.

AI.tldr: LLMs在低资源语言翻译中面临挑战，本文通过形式语法任务测试LLMs能否根据上下文语法描述进行字符串转换，发现语法规模、句子长度、形态差异和书写系统都会显著影响翻译准确性。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言缺乏训练数据，但LLMs可能通过上下文中的语言描述（如教科书、词典）来学习翻译。本文旨在测试LLMs是否能够根据形式语法描述进行语言转换，从而评估其在低资源语言翻译中的潜力。
AI.method: 构建同步上下文无关文法来定义形式语言对，模拟自然语言的语法、形态和书写特征。在不同条件下测试LLMs：改变语法规模、句子长度、语言形态差异和书写系统，测量LLMs根据给定语法将源语言句子翻译成目标语言的能力。
AI.result: 1. LLMs翻译准确率随语法规模和句子长度增加而显著下降；2. 源语言和目标语言之间的形态差异和书写系统差异会严重降低模型性能；3. 错误分析显示模型主要错误类型包括：错误回忆目标语言词汇、幻觉生成新词、以及未翻译源语言词汇。
AI.conclusion: LLMs虽然能够利用上下文语法描述进行翻译，但其性能受到语法复杂度、句子长度和语言差异的显著限制。这表明在低资源语言翻译中，仅依赖LLMs的上下文学习能力可能不足，需要更有效的机制来处理复杂的语言结构差异。

title: ClickGuard: A Trustworthy Adaptive Fusion Framework for Clickbait Detection
summary: The widespread use of clickbait headlines, crafted to mislead and maximize engagement, poses a significant challenge to online credibility. These headlines employ sensationalism, misleading claims, and vague language, underscoring the need for effective detection to ensure trustworthy digital content. The paper introduces, ClickGuard: a trustworthy adaptive fusion framework for clickbait detection. It combines BERT embeddings and structural features using a Syntactic-Semantic Adaptive Fusion Block (SSAFB) for dynamic integration. The framework incorporates a hybrid CNN-BiLSTM to capture patterns and dependencies. The model achieved 96.93% testing accuracy, outperforming state-of-the-art approaches. The model's trustworthiness is evaluated using LIME and Permutation Feature Importance (PFI) for interpretability and perturbation analysis. These methods assess the model's robustness and sensitivity to feature changes by measuring the average prediction variation. Ablation studies validated the SSAFB's effectiveness in optimizing feature fusion. The model demonstrated robust performance across diverse datasets, providing a scalable, reliable solution for enhancing online content credibility by addressing syntactic-semantic modelling challenges. Code of the work is available at: https://github.com/palindromeRice/ClickBait_Detection_Architecture

AI.tldr: ClickGuard：基于BERT嵌入和结构特征的自适应融合框架，通过语法-语义自适应融合块和混合CNN-BiLSTM实现点击诱饵检测，准确率达96.93%
AI.motivation: 点击诱饵标题的广泛使用对在线可信度构成重大挑战，这些标题采用耸人听闻、误导性声明和模糊语言，需要有效的检测方法来确保可信的数字内容
AI.method: 提出ClickGuard框架，结合BERT嵌入和结构特征，使用语法-语义自适应融合块进行动态集成，并采用混合CNN-BiLSTM捕获模式和依赖关系
AI.result: 模型达到96.93%的测试准确率，优于最先进方法；通过LIME和排列特征重要性评估可解释性，消融研究验证了SSAFB在优化特征融合方面的有效性
AI.conclusion: 该模型在不同数据集上表现出稳健性能，通过解决语法-语义建模挑战，为增强在线内容可信度提供了可扩展、可靠的解决方案

title: OpenSpatial: A Principled Data Engine for Empowering Spatial Intelligence
summary: Spatial understanding is a fundamental cornerstone of human-level intelligence. Nonetheless, current research predominantly focuses on domain-specific data production, leaving a critical void: the absence of a principled, open-source engine capable of fully unleashing the potential of high-quality spatial data. To bridge this gap, we elucidate the design principles of a robust data generation system and introduce OpenSpatial -- an open-source data engine engineered for high quality, extensive scalability, broad task diversity, and optimized efficiency. OpenSpatial adopts 3D bounding boxes as the fundamental primitive to construct a comprehensive data hierarchy across five foundational tasks: Spatial Measurement (SM), Spatial Relationship (SR), Camera Perception (CP), Multi-view Consistency (MC), and Scene-Aware Reasoning (SAR). Leveraging this scalable infrastructure, we curate OpenSpatial-3M, a large-scale dataset comprising 3 million high-fidelity samples. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that versatile models trained on our dataset achieve state-of-the-art performance across a wide spectrum of spatial reasoning benchmarks. Notably, the best-performing model exhibits a substantial average improvement of 19 percent, relatively. Furthermore, we provide a systematic analysis of how data attributes influence spatial perception. By open-sourcing both the engine and the 3M-scale dataset, we provide a robust foundation to accelerate future research in spatial intelligence.

AI.tldr: OpenSpatial是一个开源空间数据引擎，采用3D边界框作为基础单元，构建了包含5个核心任务的数据层次结构，并发布了包含300万高质量样本的OpenSpatial-3M数据集，显著提升了空间推理模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 当前空间智能研究主要关注特定领域的数据生成，缺乏一个能够充分发挥高质量空间数据潜力的原则性开源引擎。为了填补这一空白，需要建立一个能够支持高质量、可扩展、任务多样且高效的空间数据生成系统。
AI.method: 提出OpenSpatial开源数据引擎，采用3D边界框作为基础单元，构建了包含五个核心任务的数据层次结构：空间测量、空间关系、相机感知、多视图一致性和场景感知推理。基于这一可扩展基础设施，创建了包含300万高质量样本的OpenSpatial-3M大规模数据集。
AI.result: 在该数据集上训练的通用模型在广泛的空间推理基准测试中取得了最先进的性能。表现最佳的模型相对平均提升了19%。研究还系统分析了数据属性如何影响空间感知能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过开源引擎和300万规模的数据集，为加速未来空间智能研究提供了坚实基础。OpenSpatial填补了高质量空间数据生成系统的空白，推动了空间理解这一人类智能基础能力的研究进展。

title: Personalized RewardBench: Evaluating Reward Models with Human Aligned Personalization
summary: Pluralistic alignment has emerged as a critical frontier in the development of Large Language Models (LLMs), with reward models (RMs) serving as a central mechanism for capturing diverse human values. While benchmarks for general response quality are prevalent, evaluating how well reward models account for individual user preferences remains an open challenge. To bridge this gap, we introduce Personalized RewardBench, a novel benchmark designed to rigorously assess reward models' capacity to model personalized preferences. We construct chosen and rejected response pairs based on strict adherence to (or violation of) user-specific rubrics, ensuring that preference distinctions are uniquely tailored to the individual. In particular, human evaluations confirm that the primary discriminative factor between pairs is strictly personal preference, with both responses maintaining high general quality (e.g., correctness, relevance and helpfulness). Extensive testing reveals that existing state-of-the-art reward models struggle significantly with personalization, peaking at an accuracy of just 75.94%. Crucially, because an effective reward model benchmark should predict a reward model's performance on downstream tasks, we conduct experiments demonstrating that our benchmark exhibits a significantly higher correlation with downstream performance in both Best-of-N (BoN) sampling and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) compared to existing baselines. These findings establish Personalized RewardBench as a robust and accurate proxy for evaluating reward models' performance in downstream applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Personalized RewardBench基准，用于评估奖励模型在个性化偏好建模方面的能力，发现现有SOTA奖励模型在个性化任务上表现不佳（最高仅75.94%准确率），且该基准与下游任务性能相关性更高。
AI.motivation: 当前虽然存在大量评估LLM响应质量的基准，但缺乏专门评估奖励模型如何考虑个体用户偏好的方法。随着多元对齐成为LLM发展的关键前沿，需要能够评估奖励模型捕捉多样化人类价值能力的基准。
AI.method: 构建基于用户特定规则的选定和拒绝响应对，确保偏好区分完全针对个体。通过人工评估确认配对间的主要区分因素是严格的个人偏好，同时保证两种响应都保持高质量。使用该基准测试现有奖励模型，并验证其与下游任务（Best-of-N采样和PPO）性能的相关性。
AI.result: 现有最先进的奖励模型在个性化任务上表现显著不足，最高准确率仅为75.94%。更重要的是，Personalized RewardBench与下游任务性能的相关性显著高于现有基线，在BoN采样和PPO中都表现出更好的预测能力。
AI.conclusion: Personalized RewardBench是一个稳健且准确的代理基准，能够有效评估奖励模型在下游应用中的性能，填补了评估奖励模型个性化偏好建模能力的空白。
